items.titleEn: Watch top prospect Parker play at High-A on Wednesday
bodyEn: All season long, baseball fans can watch Minor League Baseball games for free on the Bally Sports Live app or at BallySports.com. Fans may also purchase an MLB+ subscription, which includes access to MiLB games live and on demand, live MLB audio for all 30 teams, MLB Network, and MLB Big Inning.
Get tickets to a Minor League game near you »
Plus -- with or without a subscription -- Minor League games featuring MLB's top prospects are available FREE at the top of this article and on the MLB Pipeline and MiLB homepages.
TUESDAY

6:05 p.m. ET: Scranton/Wilkes-Barre RailRiders (NYY) vs. Worcester Red Sox (BOS)After dominating at Double-A with a .994 OPS and 19 homers, Franklin Arias (BOS No. 1/MLB No. 3) was promoted to Triple-A in late July, and the returns have been very positive. Through 23 games, the 20-year-old infielder has proven his hot bat wasn't a fluke, posting a .292/.363/.483 slash line as the second-youngest player at the level. Arias, who has grown into massive power this season, will step into the box against Kyle Carr (NYY No. 13) and Scranton/Wilkes-Barre. Carr, the 2025 South Atlantic League pitcher of the year, is making his first start since being placed on the IL on July 21.
WEDNESDAY

1:35 p.m. ET: Columbus Clippers (CLE) vs. Indianapolis Indians (PIT)No hitter has been hotter this month than Ralphy Velazquez (CLE No. 2/MLB No. 32). The 2023 first-rounder -- who was just named to the Prospect Team of the Week -- entered the new series with 14 homers in 17 games this month and an astounding 1.015 slugging percentage and 1.462 OPS. It seems like Velazquez hasn't just been leaving the yard once a day either. The slugging first baseman is joined by Cooper Ingle (CLE No. 5) in a Triple-A Columbus lineup loaded with familiar names. Jhostynxon "The Password" Garcia (PIT No. 13), a right-handed hitting outfielder with impressive bat speed and plus raw power, anchors the Indianapolis lineup.

10:05 p.m. ET: Spokane Indians (COL) vs. Vancouver Canadians (TOR)Two dynamic prospects who recently reached High-A face off in this Northwest League battle. One of the top teenage outfielders in the Minors, Roldy Brito (COL No. 2/MLB No. 55), highlights the Spokane lineup. Since his July 17 promotion, Brito has slashed .303/.336/.418 across 28 games. In August alone, he has filled up the box score with four three-hit games and a four-hit performance. JoJo Parker (TOR No. 1/MLB No. 26) captains Vancouver's infield. Promoted on Aug. 11, the 2025 first-rounder hit the ground running with knocks in each of his first seven games. At just 20 years old, Parker displays a strong knowledge of the strike zone and impressive raw pop.
THURSDAY

6 p.m. ET: Erie SeaWolves (DET) vs. Altoona Curve (PIT)Last week, Zyhir Hope (DET No. 2/MLB No. 28) delivered his first signature performance in Detroit's organization on Aug. 15, when he racked up four knocks, including a homer. The muscular do-it-all outfielder with plus pop and sneaky speed leads Double-A Erie against Murf Gray (PIT No. 4/MLB No. 94) and Altoona. Gray -- the No. 73 overall pick in the 2025 Draft -- has been a revelation for Pittsburgh. He has exhibited home run power and strong bat-to-ball skills en route to becoming one of the system's top offensive prospects.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter

10:05 p.m. ET: Salt Lake Bees (LAA) vs. Tacoma Rainiers (SEA)Since the start of the 2024 season, no Minor Leaguer has launched more homers than Lazaro Montes (SEA No. 5/MLB No. 56). The 6-foot-5, 210-pound outfielder has some of the best pop in the Minors and has hammered 90 roundtrippers over the past three seasons. On Friday, he connected on a scorching 115.9 mph roundtripper. He's joined in Triple-A Tacoma's lineup by Michael Arroyo (SEA No. 3/MLB No. 45) -- a 5-foot-10 right-handed hitter with compact strength. Opposing the duo is 21-year-old outfielder Nelson Rada (LAA No. 6). Rada uses his above-average contact skills and speed to collect knocks and create offense.
FRIDAY

6:45 p.m. ET: Binghamton Rumble Ponies vs. Reading Fightin PhilsFuture NL East rivals go head-to-head at Double-A as Gage Wood (PHI No. 1/MLB No. 33) toes the rubber vs. Mets Trade Deadline acquisition Jefferson Rojas (NYM No. 1/MLB No. 76). Wood, a 2025 first-rounder out of Arkansas, has one of the best four-seamers in the Minors -- a 70-grade offering with a flat approach angle and good life. In his most recent outing, he fanned rehabbing Red Sox outfielder Roman Anthony en route to five scoreless innings. Rojas left the yard three times last week, giving a sneak peek into his profile as a 20-homer infielder with above-average hitting and speed.
SATURDAY

7:05 p.m. ET: Arkansas Travelers (SEA) vs. Wichita Wind Surge (MIN)Ryan Sloan (SEA No. 2/MLB No. 8) took over as Double-A Arkansas' ace and promptly racked up 11 punchouts over six innings of one-hit ball last week. He retired the first six batters he faced on swinging strikeouts and produced 21 whiffs. Having solidified his status as one of the elite pitching prospects in the Minors, Sloan faces a Wichita squad led by Marek Houston (MIN No. 4/MLB No. 74), a contact-first shortstop with smooth hands in the field. The Travelers lineup also features switch-hitting shortstop Felnin Celesten (SEA No. 4/MLB No. 50) and speedy outfielder Jonny Farmelo (SEA No. 6/MLB No. 73).

9:35 p.m. ET: Sacramento River Cats (SF) vs. Reno Aces (AZ)Bo Davidson (SF No. 8) has made good on his "JUCO Barry Bonds" nickname this season. The non-drafted signee earned the moniker thanks to his powerful bat and has blossomed into one San Francisco's top hitting prospects. He entered the week tied for the system lead with 25 big flies after walloping two homers last series. Representing the other end of this duel of NL West affiliates is Demetrio Crisantes (AZ No. 1/MLB No. 75). Equipped with a smooth right-handed stroke that leads to tons of contact, the Arizona native sprays base hits all over the yard for Reno.
SUNDAY

5:05 p.m. ET: Charleston RiverDogs (TB) vs. Columbia Fireflies (KC)The No. 2 overall pick in the 2026 Draft, Grady Emerson (TB No. 1/MLB No. 10), made his pro debut for Single-A Charleston last week. At just 18 years old, Emerson -- who has a 65-grade hit tool -- stands out for his polished skill set. He routinely barrels balls, makes good swing decisions and stacks quality at-bats. Alongside Emerson will be toolsy shortstop Cooper Flemming (TB No. 5/MLB No. 83). On the other side of the matchup will be infielder Josh Hammond (KC No. 2/MLB No. 70), an uber-athletic teenager with good power, speed and an elite arm.

8 p.m. ET: Ontario Tower Buzzers (LAD) vs. Stockton Ports (ATH)Drew Burress (ATH No. 2/MLB No. 41) proved one main thing during his three seasons at Georgia Tech -- he can flat out rake. The 21-year-old outfielder set the program record with 60 career homers, then followed it up by swatting three jacks in his first five games as a pro. Burress' big bat leads a Single-A Stockton lineup that also has Japanese "three-way" prospect Shotaro Morii (ATH No. 16), who will DH in the contest. In the other dugout will be breakout Dodgers outfield prospect Ching-Hsien Ko (LAD No. 12). Signed in 2024 out of Taiwan, Ko entered the week with a career-high 18 homers this season.

美国东部时间下午6:05：Scranton/Wilkes-Barre RailRiders（洋基）对阵Worcester Red Sox（红袜）。在2A以.994 OPS和19支本垒打统治赛场后，Franklin Arias（红袜第1/MLB第3）于7月底升上3A，而他的表现非常出色。在23场比赛中，这位20岁内野手证明了他火烫的球棒并非昙花一现，打出.292/.363/.483的打击三围，是该级别第二年轻的球员。本赛季力量大幅成长的Arias将对阵Kyle Carr（洋基第13）和Scranton/Wilkes-Barre。Carr是2025年南大西洋联盟年度最佳投手，这是他自7月21日进入伤病名单以来首次先发。
星期三

美国东部时间下午1:35：Columbus Clippers（守护者）对阵Indianapolis Indians（海盗）。本月没有打者比Ralphy Velazquez（守护者第2/MLB第32）更火热。这位2023年首轮秀——刚刚入选本周潜力新秀阵容——带着本月17场比赛14支本垒打、惊人的1.015长打率和1.462 OPS进入新系列赛。看起来Velazquez似乎不仅仅每天一次把球轰出球场。这位强力一垒手在3A Columbus阵容中与Cooper Ingle（守护者第5）携手，阵中满是熟悉的名字。Jhostynxon "The Password" Garcia（海盗第13）是Indianapolis阵容的中坚，他是一名右手打击外野手，拥有惊人的挥棒速度和出色的原始力量。

美国东部时间晚上10:05：Spokane Indians（洛矶）对阵Vancouver Canadians（蓝鸟）。两位近期升上高阶A的活力新秀将在西北联盟的较量中正面交锋。小联盟最顶尖的青少年外野手之一Roldy Brito（洛矶第2/MLB第55）是Spokane阵容的亮点。自7月17日升上来以来，Brito在28场比赛中打出.303/.336/.418的打击三围。仅8月份，他就打出了四场三安打和一场四安打的表现，填满技术统计。JoJo Parker（蓝鸟第1/MLB第26）镇守Vancouver的内野。作为2025年首轮秀，他于8月11日升上高阶A，随即进入状态，前七场比赛场场有安打。年仅20岁的Parker展现出对好球带的出色理解和惊人的原始力量。
星期四

美国东部时间下午6:00：Erie SeaWolves（老虎）对阵Altoona Curve（海盗）。上周，Zyhir Hope（老虎第2/MLB第28）于8月15日在底特律体系中打出了他的首场标志性表现，他击出四支安打，包括一支本垒打。这位肌肉发达的全能外野手拥有出色的力量和隐蔽的速度，他将率领2A Erie迎战Murf Gray（海盗第4/MLB第94）和Altoona。Gray——2025年选秀大会第73顺位——是匹兹堡的一大发现。他展现出了本垒打威力和扎实的击球能力，逐渐成为球队体系中顶级的进攻新秀之一。

美国东部时间晚上10:05：Salt Lake Bees（天使）对阵Tacoma Rainiers（水手）。自2024赛季开始以来，没有小联盟球员比Lazaro Montes（水手第5/MLB第56）击出更多本垒打。这位6英尺5英寸、210磅的外野手拥有小联盟顶级的力量，过去三个赛季敲出了90支本垒打。周五，他击出一支时速115.9英里的火热本垒打。与他一同在3A Tacoma阵容中的是Michael Arroyo（水手第3/MLB第45）——一位5英尺10英寸的右手打者，拥有紧凑的力量。对阵这对组合的是21岁外野手Nelson Rada（天使第6）。Rada凭借高于平均的击球能力和速度来积攒安打并创造攻势。
星期五

美国东部时间下午6:45：Binghamton Rumble Ponies对阵Reading Fightin Phils。未来的国联东区对手将在2A正面交锋，Gage Wood（费城人第1/MLB第33）踏上投手丘，对阵大都会交易截止日获得的Jefferson Rojas（大都会第1/MLB第76）。Wood是2025年来自阿肯色大学的首轮秀，他拥有小联盟最好的四缝线快速球之一——70分的球路，出手角度平，尾劲出色。最近一次出赛，他三振了正在康复中的红袜外野手Roman Anthony，投出五局无失分。Rojas上周三度开轰，让人得以一窥他作为一名20轰内野手、拥有高于平均打击和速度的全面身手。
星期六

美国东部时间晚上7:05：Arkansas Travelers（水手）对阵Wichita Wind Surge（双城）。Ryan Sloan（水手第2/MLB第8）成为2A Arkansas的王牌，上周他投出六局一安打、11次三振的出色表现。他让前六名打者全部挥空三振出局，并制造了21次挥空。在巩固了自己作为小联盟精英投手新秀的地位后，Sloan将面对由Marek Houston（双城第4/MLB第74）领衔的Wichita阵容，后者是一名以击球为先、防守手感流畅的游击手。Travelers阵容还包括左右开弓的游击手Felnin Celesten（水手第4/MLB第50）和速度型外野手Jonny Farmelo（水手第6/MLB第73）。

美国东部时间晚上9:35：Sacramento River Cats（巨人）对阵Reno Aces（响尾蛇）。Bo Davidson（巨人第8）本赛季配得上他“JUCO Barry Bonds”的绰号。这位非选秀签约球员凭借强大的球棒赢得了这个绰号，如今已成长为旧金山顶级的打击新秀之一。在上一轮系列赛敲出两轰后，他带着25轰进入本周，并列队内第一。代表这场国联西区附属球队对决另一方的则是Demetrio Crisantes（响尾蛇第1/MLB第75）。他拥有流畅的右手挥棒，能制造大量击球，这位亚利桑那本地人为Reno将安打打向球场的各个方向。
星期日

美国东部时间下午5:05：Charleston RiverDogs（光芒）对阵Columbia Fireflies（皇家）。作为2026年选秀的榜眼秀，Grady Emerson（光芒第1/MLB第10）上周在1A Charleston完成了职业首秀。年仅18岁的Emerson——拥有65分的击球能力——以其精湛的技术脱颖而出。他经常能击中球心，做出良好的挥棒选择，并积累高质量的出场打击。与Emerson并肩作战的将是运动能力出色的游击手Cooper Flemming（光芒第5/MLB第83）。对手阵中则有内野手Josh Hammond（皇家第2/MLB第70），一位运动能力超强的青少年，拥有出色的力量、速度和精英手臂。

美国东部时间晚上8:00：Ontario Tower Buzzers（道奇）对阵Stockton Ports（运动家）。在佐治亚理工的三年里，Drew Burress（运动家第2/MLB第41）证明了一件事——他极其擅长打击。这位21岁外野手以60支职业生涯本垒打创下校史纪录，随后在职业生涯前五场比赛中敲出三轰。Burress的强力球棒领衔1A Stockton阵容，其中还有日本“三刀流”新秀Shotaro Morii（运动家第16），他将在本场担任指定打击。对方替补席中则是迎来爆发的道奇外野新秀Ching-Hsien Ko（道奇第12）。这位2024年从台湾签下的球员，带着职业生涯新高的单季18轰进入本周。

items.titleEn: These 10 farm systems have the best pitching prospects
bodyEn: This story is the third in a series in which MLB Pipeline ranks the Top 10 MLB farm systems by position: Infielders | Outfielders | Pitchers | Catchers (coming Thur.)

We went from the dirt to the grass ... and now to the mound. While the leaders for infielders (Brewers) and outfielders (Dodgers) were pretty much slam dunks, this ranking based on pitching prospects was a lot more muddled/closer at the top.

Arguments could be made for any of the top four or five organizations listed below to be in the top spot, or at least a few slots higher. With pitching so mercurial, this ranking could look a whole lot different in the near future.

1. Miami MarlinsRight out of the gate, we’re starting with a bit of a speculative, "what if" kind of pick at the top. On paper, it makes a lot of sense: The Marlins are one of just two teams with three pitchers on the Top 100: Thomas White (No. 37), Robby Snelling (No. 53) and Karson Milbrandt (No. 78). White and Snelling are in the top half of the Top 10 LHP prospects list and all three are 22 years old or younger while at the highest levels of the system. But -- and it’s a big but -- White and Snelling have thrown a combined 58 2/3 innings in 2026. White’s shoulder sprain has kept him out since mid-May and Snelling’s Tommy John surgery will keep him out through mid-2027. The other pitcher in Miami’s top 10 is Kevin Defrank, and he has Top 100-type stuff, but he didn’t pitch this year, either, with a right bicep injury. A return to health from that trio alone would make this a clear-cut choice.

2. St. Louis CardinalsWhile the Cardinals have only one Top 100 arm in the system in Liam Doyle (No. 44) -- and he’s posted a 1.75 ERA and .157 batting average against since the beginning of July -- it’s a very deep crop. St. Louis has 13 pitchers on its top 30, five in the top 10 alone. No organization has more pitchers on a top 30 with a 45 or better overall grade than the Cardinals’ 12. Top 10 pitchers in the system Tanner Franklin, Quinn Mathews and Brandon Clarke have been joined by 2026 draftee Tegan Kuhns, who had first-round stuff and ended up going No. 32 overall, in Competitive Balance Round A. Jurrangelo Cijntje hasn’t had a good year, his first in the organization, but it speaks to the depth of this group, and Top 30 overall, that his arm talent is sixth in this org and No. 12 on the Top 30.

3. Washington NationalsThe Nationals match the Cardinals in having 13 hurlers on their Top 30 and come a close second with 11 of them earning a 45 or better overall grade. Their pair of Top 100 guys -- Travis Sykora (No. 52) and Jarlin Susana (No. 68) -- offer a combined 13 feet of pure power pitcher. The two 6-foot-6 right-handers have both dealt with elbow injuries and surgeries, though, keeping Sykora off the mound for all of this season and Susana sidelined until August of this year. Meanwhile, Jackson Kent has pitched his way to the big leagues from Double-A and has moved into the team’s top 10 while flamethrower Miguel Sime Jr. has missed an absurd amount of bats (16.3 K/9) while showing he has a long way to go in terms of command (8.2 BB/9).

4. Baltimore OriolesNot long ago, the O’s were known for their hitting depth and it seemed as if they couldn’t draft, sign and develop pitching at all. Now they have three pitchers in the Top 100, getting a pair of Top 10 lefties in Joseph Dzierwa (No. 89) and Caden Hunter (No. 97) in the 2025 Draft and acquiring right-hander Anthony Eyanson (No. 49) from the Red Sox in the Adley Rutschman deal. All three of them are in what has to be the deepest Minor League rotation in baseball (Double-A Chesapeake), especially when you consider that big righty J.T. Quinn is there now, too, and he’s No. 14 on Baltimore’s Top 30. Lefty Luis De Leon has Top 100-caliber pure stuff and he’s joined in the system’s top 10 by another Trade Deadline acquisition, Michael Forret, in the top 10 and the Triple-A rotation.

5. Seattle MarinersThe dynamic duo of Kade Anderson (No. 5) and Ryan Sloan (No. 8) alone could be enough to vault the Mariners up this list. Anderson has led the Minors in just about every statistical category imaginable while Sloan had been his rotation-mate, at age 20, in Double-A until Anderson got called up. The main reason why Seattle isn’t higher in this ranking is there’s a drop off pitching-wise in the system after their top two. The M’s only have two other arms in their top 15: promising lefty Mason Peters and right-hander Griffin Hugus, who had Tommy John surgery this spring. Both are from the 2025 Draft class and the crop did get buoyed by 2026 third-rounder Nathan Taylor, who comes in at No. 17.

6. San Francisco GiantsThey’re already No. 2 on the infield list, and that might be the main reason for their big leap all the way up to No. 5 on our farm system rankings. But their growing pitching crop is nothing to sneeze at, either. Adding Jackson Flora (No. 31) via the Draft and Ramon Marquez at the Trade Deadline (No. 99) was huge in terms of high-end talent on the mound. But that’s not all they have, with their 16 pitchers on the top 30, the second-highest total in baseball. After getting Flora from the college group, they spent lavishly to add high-end high school arms in Carson Bolemon and Kaden Waechter in Competitive Balance Round A and the second round, respectively, and added intriguing pitchers Henry Lalane and Miguel Mendez at the Trade Deadline while 2024 Deadline acquisition Jacob Bresnahan has thrown well this year.

7. Detroit TigersThe Tigers boast just a single Top 100 arm, with River Ryan (No. 66) recently joining the organization via the Tarik Skubal trade. But there’s some depth here, with 12 total pitchers in the top 30, five of whom hit Detroit’s top 10. Ben Jacobs has been in the system all year, courtesy of the 2025 Draft, and now he has company: 2026 first-rounder Cameron Flukey and trade acquisitions Kash Mayfield (Casey Mize deal) and Brady Smith (Skubal) are all in the top 10 with him.

8. Toronto Blue JaysThere are some enigmas in this group, with injuries playing a big part in that, but the Blue Jays have been able to find some interesting talent, and not necessarily at the top of a Draft. Their lone Top 100 pitcher, Nolan Perry (No. 95), was a 12th-round pick in 2022, while bat-missing lefty Johnny King was a third-rounder in 2024. Even Cole Carlon, who was Toronto’s first pick in 2026, was the No. 39 overall pick. That gives the Jays three arms in their top five alone, while the trade acquisition of Dasan Hill gives them a high-ceilinged, albeit inconsistent, southpaw in their top 10.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter

9. Texas RangersThe last of six organizations with two or more Top 100 pitchers -- the other five are above -- the Rangers’ pitching contingent is led by 2025 breakout Caden Scarborough (No. 77) and 2026 first-round pick Gio Rojas (No. 96). They have 13 total arms on their top 30 with an average overall grade of 45, tying them with the Giants for eighth-best among all 30 systems. They were able to add a high-end arm in Brody Brumila in the third round of the Draft, though he’ll have to recover from Tommy John surgery first. And if two-way players Seong-Jun Kim and Josh Owens end up focusing on the mound, it will make this group even deeper.

10. Pittsburgh PiratesHaving a top prospect like Bubba Chandler graduate will knock a team down a few notches, as does some inconsistent performances from guys like Hunter Barco and Thomas Harrington; the Pirates were at No. 2 last year. Seth Hernandez (No. 7) helps keep them on the list, while Levi Sterling has the chance to make a big jump forward in 2027.
items.titleZh: 拥有最佳投手新秀的十大农场系统
items.summaryZh: MLB Pipeline评选出拥有最佳投手新秀的十大农场系统，马林鱼居首，红雀、国民紧随其后。
bodyZh: 这是MLB Pipeline按位置评选十大MLB农场系统系列报道的第三篇：内野手 | 外野手 | 投手 | 捕手（周四推出）。
我们从内野的泥土走向外野的草地……现在来到了投手丘。内野手（酿酒人）和外野手（道奇）的榜首几乎是毫无悬念，而基于投手新秀的这份排名则要混乱得多，各队之间差距也很小。
下面列出的前四或前五支球队中，任何一支都有理由占据榜首，或者至少排名更靠前几位。由于投手的状态变化莫测，这份排名在不久的将来可能会大不相同。

1. 迈阿密马林鱼首先，我们以一个带有猜测性和“如果”性质的榜首选择开始。从纸面上看，这很有道理：马林鱼是仅有的两支拥有三名百大新秀投手的球队之一，他们是Thomas White（第37位）、Robby Snelling（第53位）和Karson Milbrandt（第78位）。White和Snelling都位列左投新秀前十榜单的上半部分，而且三人在升至球队最高级别时年龄都不超过22岁。但是——这是一个很大的“但是”——White和Snelling在2026年合计只投了58又2/3局。White因肩部扭伤自5月中旬缺阵，Snelling接受汤米·约翰手术后将缺阵至2027年中期。迈阿密前十的另外一名投手是Kevin Defrank，他拥有百大新秀级别的实力，但今年也因右二头肌伤势没有投球。仅这三人恢复健康就足以让这份选择毫无疑问。

2. 圣路易斯红雀虽然红雀队中只有Liam Doyle（第44位）一名百大新秀投手——而且他自7月初以来自责分率为1.75，被打击率为.157——但这是一个非常深厚的群体。圣路易斯有13名投手进入其前30新秀，仅前10就有5名。没有哪支球队的前30新秀中，综合评分达到45或以上的投手数量比红雀的12名更多。球队前十投手Tanner Franklin、Quinn Mathews和Brandon Clarke迎来了2026年选秀球员Tegan Kuhns的加入，他拥有首轮秀的实力，最终在竞争性平衡轮A以总第32顺位被选中。Jurrangelo Cijntje在球队的第一年表现不佳，但这恰恰说明了这一群体的深度以及前30新秀的整体实力：他的手臂天赋在这支球队中排名第六，在前30中排名第12。

3. 华盛顿国民国民队与红雀队一样，前30新秀中有13名投手，其中11人综合评分达到45或以上，紧随其后排名第二。他们的两位百大新秀——Travis Sykora（第52位）和Jarlin Susana（第68位）——合起来提供了13英尺的纯粹力量型投手。这两位身高6英尺6英寸的右投手都曾遭受肘部伤病并接受手术，这使得Sykora整个赛季都无法登板，Susana直到今年8月才复出。与此同时，Jackson Kent从2A一路投进了大联盟，并进入了球队前十；而火球男Miguel Sime Jr.虽然三振能力惊人（每9局16.3次三振），但控球方面还有很长的路要走（每9局8.2次保送）。

4. 巴尔的摩金莺不久前，金莺队还以打击深度著称，似乎他们完全无法选秀、签约和培养投手。如今他们在百大新秀中拥有三名投手，在2025年选秀中得到了两位前十左投Joseph Dzierwa（第89位）和Caden Hunter（第97位），并通过Adley Rutschman交易从红袜队换来了右投手Anthony Eyanson（第49位）。这三人都在堪称棒球界最深厚的2A小联盟轮值（2A切萨皮克）中，尤其是当你考虑到大个子右投J.T. Quinn现在也在那里，而且他在巴尔的摩前30中排名第14。左投Luis De Leon拥有百大新秀级别的纯粹实力，另一位交易截止日引进的球员Michael Forret也加入了球队前十，并进入3A轮值。

5. 西雅图水手Kade Anderson（第5位）和Ryan Sloan（第8位）这对充满活力的组合本身就足以让水手队在这份榜单上跃升。Anderson几乎在各项小联盟统计中都领跑，而Sloan在Anderson被升上大联盟之前，一直以20岁的年龄在2A与他并肩轮值。西雅图在这份排名中未能更高的主要原因是，在球队前两名投手之后，投手深度出现了断层。水手队在前15中只有另外两名投手：有前景的左投Mason Peters和右投Griffin Hugus，后者今年春天接受了汤米·约翰手术。两人都来自2025年选秀，而2026年第三轮选中的Nathan Taylor（第17位）也为这批新秀增添了成色。

6. 旧金山巨人巨人队已经在内野手榜单上排名第二，这可能是他们在我们农场系统排名中跃升至第五的主要原因。但他们日益壮大的投手群体也不容小觑。通过选秀得到Jackson Flora（第31位）以及交易截止日得到Ramon Marquez（第99位），对球队的高端投手天赋来说是巨大的补充。但这还不是全部，他们的前30新秀中有16名投手，是棒球界第二多的。在从大学球员中选中Flora后，他们投入重金，在竞争性平衡轮A和第二轮分别选中了高中高端投手Carson Bolemon和Kaden Waechter，并在交易截止日引入了有吸引力的投手Henry Lalane和Miguel Mendez，而2024年交易截止日引进的Jacob Bresnahan今年也投得不错。

7. 底特律老虎老虎队只有一名百大新秀投手，River Ryan（第66位）最近通过Tarik Skubal交易加入球队。但这里也有一些深度，前30中有12名投手，其中5人进入底特律前十。Ben Jacobs通过2025年选秀整年都在体系中，现在他有伴了：2026年首轮秀Cameron Flukey以及交易得到的Kash Mayfield（Casey Mize交易）和Brady Smith（Skubal交易）都与他一同进入前十。

8. 多伦多蓝鸟这个群体中有一些谜团，伤病在其中扮演了重要角色，但蓝鸟队已经能够找到一些有趣的天才，而且未必是在选秀的高顺位。他们唯一的百大新秀投手Nolan Perry（第95位）是2022年第12轮选中的，而善于制造挥空的左投Johnny King是2024年第三轮秀。即使是多伦多2026年的首轮秀Cole Carlon，也只是总第39顺位。这使得蓝鸟队在前五中就有三名投手，而交易得到的Dasan Hill为他们前十增添了一位上限很高但表现不稳定的左投。
订阅MLB Pipeline新闻通讯

9. 得克萨斯游骑兵得克萨斯游骑兵是六支拥有两名或以上百大新秀投手的球队中的最后一支——另外五支在上面——他们的投手阵容由2025年爆发的Caden Scarborough（第77位）和2026年首轮秀Gio Rojas（第96位）领衔。他们的前30新秀中共有13名投手，平均综合评分为45，与巨人队并列所有30支系统中的第八位。他们在选秀第三轮得到了高端投手Brody Brumila，不过他需要先接受汤米·约翰手术恢复。如果二刀流球员Seong-Jun Kim和Josh Owens最终专注于投球，这个群体的深度将进一步增加。
10. 匹兹堡海盗像Bubba Chandler这样的顶级新秀升入大联盟会让球队的排名下降几个位次，Hunter Barco和Thomas Harrington等人的不稳定表现也同样如此；海盗队去年排名第二。Seth Hernandez（第7位）帮助他们留在这份榜单上，而Levi Sterling有机会在2027年实现大幅跃升。

items.titleEn: With Bieber becoming latest starter on IL, who steps up in Toronto's rotation?
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Remember Spring Training? It was only a decade ago.
The Blue Jays had eight healthy, legitimate big league starters. Those early days of camp, always so full of hope, were spent wondering just how they’d put that puzzle together.

Well, we’re still wondering the same thing, but for much different reasons. The Blue Jays are stuck in one of the worst runs of pitching injuries this organization has ever seen, which continued Tuesday when Shane Bieber hit the 15-day IL with right teres major inflammation. He’ll be shut down from throwing for the next couple of weeks, with the Blue Jays still holding out hope that he can return later in this stretch run.
Add that to this list of Blue Jays pitching injuries this season:

Cody Ponce: Torn right ACLJosé Berríos: Tommy John surgeryShane Bieber: Right elbow inflammation, missed first 78 gamesTrey Yesavage: Right meniscus injuryMax Scherzer: Right forearm, left ankle and back injuriesPatrick Corbin: Left teres major strainBowden Francis: Tommy John surgeryJameson Taillon: Forearm tendinitis

Along with Bieber, Yesavage seems to fall into that same bucket, where the Blue Jays hope he can ride in to save the day before the season ends. He’s playing catch and the range of motion in his knee is better than expected already, but he’s still a long way off.

So, once again we must ask, how are the Blue Jays going to put this puzzle together? Their current rotation is built on Dylan Cease, José Soriano and Max Scherzer, with Spencer Arrighetti sliding back in this Thursday, fresh off the IL himself. The No. 5 job is a bullpen day for now, and if we’ve learned anything this season, it’s that the Blue Jays need to brace themselves for the possibility that something else goes wrong between now and the end of September, too.
This is where their depth stands right now:
Short-term starting options

Jameson Taillon: The veteran righty is scheduled to pitch with Triple-A Buffalo on Friday. If that goes well, with a pitch count around 50, the Blue Jays sound comfortable with Taillon sliding right into the rotation the next time through. This was the lone piece of pleasant news to come out of Tuesday. Taillon was stuck in a difficult season before being designated for assignment with the Cubs, but sounded rejuvenated after coming over via trade, recommitted to attacking the zone after shying away from that earlier in the year.

John Klein: Klein came over from the Twins in the Jeff Hoffman trade after making his brief MLB debut earlier this season, so the 24-year-old is “ready” enough. Klein is right on that line between a starter and a “bulk” guy, but with pitch counts of 70 and 60 his last two times out in Buffalo, he could theoretically give the Blue Jays four-plus innings in a spot start.

CJ Van Eyk: Also benefitting from a 40-man roster spot, Van Eyk was up to 78 pitches in his last start for Triple-A Buffalo. There’s some versatility here, too, with Van Eyk also able to slide into the bullpen role he pitched in earlier this season with the Blue Jays, including one relief appearance with 69 pitches over 3 1/3 innings.

Josh Fleming: Fleming made one appearance with the Blue Jays earlier this season and has bounced around, but a lefty with a 3.39 ERA in Triple-A this season still gets a piece of the conversation, especially if there’s a lefty-heavy lineup waiting. Fleming isn’t on the 40-man roster, though, meaning someone like Klein may have the inside track.
Bulk options

Simeon Woods Richardson: Also close to that line between starter and bulk reliever, Woods Richardson has stuck around as a legitimate option for the Blue Jays. His 1.04 ERA with the Blue Jays isn’t sustainable when you look at the peripheral numbers, but at this point, innings are innings. In Wednesday’s bullpen game, Woods Richardson could give the Blue Jays 40-50 pitches.

Chad Dallas: Better than his big-league numbers this season, Dallas is a swingman with good breaking stuff who should show better when he’s allowed to settle into a role. Given the roster expansion coming on Sept. 1, when the Blue Jays will be able to keep one additional pitcher, it’s likely that Dallas is here to stay down the stretch. Whether it’s following an opener or pitching in tandem with Woods Richardson, he can be one piece of creating a “start”.
items.titleZh: Shane Bieber进入伤病名单，蓝鸟轮值谁顶上？
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟遭遇严重投手伤病潮，Shane Bieber进入15天伤病名单，球队轮值深度面临考验，谁将顶上？
bodyZh: 多伦多——还记得春训吗？那感觉就像在十年前。
蓝鸟曾拥有八名健康、货真价实的大联盟先发投手。春训初期总是充满希望，当时球队还在琢磨该如何拼凑这套轮值。
好吧，我们仍在思考同样的问题，但原因大不相同。蓝鸟正陷入队史最严重的投手伤病潮之一，周二又添新伤，Shane Bieber因右侧大圆肌发炎进入15天伤病名单。他将在未来几周停止投球，蓝鸟仍对他能在赛季最后冲刺阶段回归抱有希望。
加上这一项，以下是蓝鸟本赛季的投手伤病名单：
Cody Ponce：右膝前交叉韧带撕裂；José Berríos：Tommy John手术；Shane Bieber：右肘炎症，缺席前78场比赛；Trey Yesavage：右半月板损伤；Max Scherzer：右前臂、左脚踝和背部伤病；Patrick Corbin：左侧大圆肌拉伤；Bowden Francis：Tommy John手术；Jameson Taillon：前臂肌腱炎。
除了Bieber，Yesavage似乎也属于同一类情况，蓝鸟希望他能在赛季结束前复出救场。他已经在进行传接球，膝盖的活动范围也比预期要好，但距离复出还有很长的路。
因此，我们再次要问：蓝鸟将如何拼凑起这套轮值？目前轮值由Dylan Cease、José Soriano和Max Scherzer领衔，Spencer Arrighetti周四将从伤病名单中回归。第五号先发目前暂时由牛棚日顶替，而且如果我们从这个赛季学到了什么，那就是蓝鸟还需要为从现在到9月底可能再出现其他状况做好准备。
以下就是他们目前的深度状况：
短期先发选项
Jameson Taillon：这位老将右投计划周五随3A水牛城队出赛。如果一切顺利，投球数在50球左右，蓝鸟似乎放心让Taillon在下一轮先发中直接回到轮值。这是周二唯一的好消息。Taillon在被小熊指定让渡之前度过了一个艰难的赛季，但通过交易加盟后显得重新焕发活力，重新致力于攻击好球带，而本赛季早些时候他对此有所回避。
John Klein：Klein今年稍早完成短暂的大联盟首秀后，在Jeff Hoffman交易中从双城来到蓝鸟，因此这位24岁球员已经“足够准备好”。Klein恰好站在先发和“长中继”投手的界线，但鉴于他最近两次在水牛城出赛的投球数分别为70和60，理论上他能在临时先发中为蓝鸟投四局以上。
CJ Van Eyk：同样受益于40人名单名额，Van Eyk最近一次为3A水牛城先发投了78球。他也有多面手属性，还能回到本赛季早些时候在蓝鸟牛棚投过的角色，其中一次后援出场是3又1/3局投了69球。
Josh Fleming：Fleming本赛季早些时候为蓝鸟出场一次，此后辗转多队，但一位在3A自责分率3.39的左投仍然值得考虑，尤其是面对左打为主的打线时。不过Fleming不在40人名单上，这意味着像Klein这样的球员可能更有优势。
长中继选项
Simeon Woods Richardson：同样介于先发和长中继之间，Woods Richardson一直是蓝鸟可靠的选择。他在蓝鸟的自责分率1.04从外围数据看难以持续，但到了这个节骨眼，能吃局数才是硬道理。周三的牛棚日，Woods Richardson可以为蓝鸟投40到50球。
Chad Dallas：Dallas的实力比他本赛季的大联盟数据所显示的更好，他是一名拥有出色变化球的摆渡人，一旦获得固定角色，表现应该会更好。考虑到9月1日名单扩编，届时蓝鸟可以额外保留一名投手，Dallas很可能会在赛季末段留队。无论是担任开场投手之后的长中继，还是与Woods Richardson搭档，他都可以成为拼凑一场“先发”的一部分。

items.titleEn: Bieber (shoulder) goes on IL, dealing another blow to Blue Jays
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Blue Jays have placed starter Shane Bieber on the 15-day IL with right teres major inflammation, another significant blow to a rotation that’s spent all season weathering them.

There was no indication this news was coming Tuesday. Bieber missed around the first half of the season, dealing with some lingering elbow and forearm issues from the Blue Jays’ World Series run in 2025, but he’s appeared to be healthy ever since he returned in late June.

Bieber has looked so much sharper in recent weeks and is coming off his best outing of the season, seven innings of one-run ball against the Rays with seven strikeouts. He’s looked like his old self, which has been perfectly timed for a team making a postseason push and a pitcher nearing free agency. Now, he’s back on the IL, right alongside too many other Blue Jays starters.

The Blue Jays have already been without José Berríos, Cody Ponce and Bowden Francis for the season, and Trey Yesavage recently joined them after undergoing surgery to repair the meniscus in his left knee. Jameson Taillon, acquired to support this rotation at the Deadline, is on the IL with a forearm injury. Bieber already spent extensive time on the IL, and Max Scherzer has seen multiple stints this season as well. Add in the fact that the Blue Jays dealt Kevin Gausman at the Trade Deadline, and this feels so far away from Spring Training, when we wondered how the Blue Jays would manage such an impressive group of starters.

As it stands, the Blue Jays’ rotation is: Dylan Cease, José Soriano, Max Scherzer and Spencer Arrighetti. Even in Arrighetti’s spot, he’s still in the process of stretching back out after a recent IL stint of his own, but anyone capable of throwing more than four innings qualifies as a “starter” right now.

This puts the Blue Jays in scramble mode once again. Chad Dallas has been recalled and can be part of the solution alongside Simeon Woods Richardson, who straddled the line between starter and “bulk reliever” but could be asked to stretch deeper. In Triple-A, the Blue Jays also have CJ Van Eyk and John Klein, but regardless of how they patch this together, it’s going to be awfully difficult to replace Bieber.
The Blue Jays open a series against the Royals at home on Tuesday.
items.titleZh: Bieber（肩伤）进入伤病名单，蓝鸟再遭打击
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟先发Bieber因右大圆肌炎症进入伤病名单，球队轮值再遭打击。
bodyZh: 多伦多——蓝鸟将先发投手Shane Bieber放入15天伤病名单，原因是右大圆肌炎症，这对整个赛季都在承受打击的先发轮值来说是又一次重大打击。
周二之前，没有任何迹象表明这一消息会传出。Bieber因2025年世界大赛期间遗留的肘部和前臂问题，缺席了大约半个赛季，但自6月底回归以来，他一直显得很健康。
Bieber最近几周表现明显更加犀利，刚刚打出了他本赛季最出色的一场比赛——对阵光芒队投了7局，只失1分，送出7次三振。他看起来已恢复巅峰状态，这对于一支正在冲击季后赛的球队和一位即将成为自由球员的投手来说，时机恰到好处。现在，他又回到了伤病名单，和太多其他蓝鸟先发投手为伍。

蓝鸟本赛季已经失去了José Berríos、Cody Ponce和Bowden Francis，Trey Yesavage在接受了左膝半月板修复手术后，最近也加入到了这一行列。在交易截止日引进以支援轮值的Jameson Taillon，目前因前臂受伤进入伤病名单。Bieber已经在伤病名单上待了很长时间，Max Scherzer本赛季也多次进出。再加上蓝鸟在交易截止日交易走了Kevin Gausman，这让人感觉与春训时相距甚远。当时，我们还在好奇蓝鸟将如何安排这一群令人印象深刻的先发投手。
就目前而言，蓝鸟的先发轮值由Dylan Cease、José Soriano、Max Scherzer和Spencer Arrighetti组成。即使是Arrighetti，他也刚刚从一次伤病名单中恢复，还在重新拉长局数的过程中。但眼下，任何能投超过四局的人都有资格被视为“先发投手”。
这让蓝鸟再次进入紧急应对模式。Chad Dallas已被召回，他可能与Simeon Woods Richardson一同成为解决方案的一部分，后者一直在先发和“长中继”之间摇摆，但也可能被要求投得更深。在3A，蓝鸟还有CJ Van Eyk和John Klein，但无论他们如何拼凑，要取代Bieber都将极为困难。
蓝鸟将于周二在主场开始与皇家队的系列赛。

items.titleEn: With 30 games left, Blue Jays have no time to coast
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Thirty games left, all against teams with .500 records or lower. Sounds like a freshly paved road to the postseason, doesn’t it?

If you’d offered this deal to the Blue Jays a month ago, they’d have taken it in a heartbeat. These past few weeks have been the fun part, a disappointing team finding new ways to exist -- and win -- following the Trade Deadline. Now comes the hard part.

Thirty games against teams at .500 or under sounds like a launching pad, but what about this Blue Jays season has come easily and what about it has made sense? This team has been batting Brett Bateman and Charles McAdoo in the leadoff spot. It’s Aug. 25 and Vladimir Guerrero Jr. hasn’t hit a home run at Rogers Centre. Do you really expect things to make sense now?
The first challenge: Last-place teams with nothing to lose
It’s important to work a bit beyond the tagline of “30 games against teams at .500 or under," because that doesn’t fully capture the story of what's been going on recently.

Take the Royals, who sit 58-74 and last place in the AL Central. That doesn’t sound all that threatening, but the Royals have won their last eight games and are fresh off an 11-7 win over the Tigers. It’s still the Bobby Witt Jr. and Jac Caglianone show, but the Royals are humming. Their rotation is pitching well and Craig Kimbrel, now on his 12th MLB team, just picked up his 441st career save. Heck, even Salvador Perez is stealing bases.
The Blue Jays open this homestand with three against the Royals, then travel to Kansas City next weekend on a three-city road trip which also includes visits to the Guardians and A’s.

We’ve talked about the Blue Jays playing like they have nothing to lose, but the Royals really have nothing to lose. There’s something dangerous about teams like the Royals, A’s or Reds down the stretch, even though they’re well out of postseason contention. With the right core and the right manager, teams like these can play loose and free, and if they’re rolling out young prospects for a taste of the big leagues down the stretch, that just adds another layer of unknown.
It’s up to the Blue Jays to not play down to their level, but we’ve seen how magnetic that pull can be.
The bigger challenge: Teams in the AL Wild Card race
Let’s not pretend that the other teams in this race are all playing the Dodgers 30 times down the stretch.

Toronto’s schedule is on the favorable side, sure, but most of these contenders are facing something similar. The Blue Jays have series coming up against the Mariners, Guardians, Orioles (twice), Tigers and Rangers, all of whom are central figures in this race. There will be massive swings from night to night and series to series.

The key factor here is motivation. Against teams like the A’s, perhaps the Blue Jays will catch an out-of-contention team on a night where they are not maxing out their bullpen. Why push your best back-end relievers to throw three out of four days if you’re completely out of contention? It’s a small edge and a small factor, but all of this matters so much in such a tight race.

In these other 18 games against legitimate Wild Card contenders, the Blue Jays will be getting the other team’s best punch every night. Just because they’re all a few games “below .500” doesn’t make it any less scary.
The big question: Which team can pull off a hot streak?

This is not the time to get excited about playing sustainable, just-above-.500 baseball with a 16-14 finish. There are currently seven teams with a legitimate shot at the final Wild Card spot, all of them within 4 1/2 games entering play Tuesday. This is not a normal Wild Card race, so it demands that one team goes on a true tear down the stretch.

Are the Blue Jays built for a hot streak? Their pitching is strong, but can this offense go seven or eight games in a row without taking a nap? Their longest winning streak is just four games this season, which isn’t encouraging. That’s also the Twins’ longest winning streak this season, but the other contenders have all put up longer ones.

The Blue Jays’ rotation is stable, their bullpen has been excellent and their defense is once again the best in baseball over the past month, but one of these teams will ride an offensive explosion to 18 or 20 wins over their final 30.
It’s a sprint now. Are the Blue Jays sprinters?
items.titleZh: 还剩30场比赛 蓝鸟已无轻松可言
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟剩余30场对手胜率均不超五成，但赛程暗藏挑战，需警惕垫底球队与外卡竞争者，并打出一波连胜。
bodyZh: 多伦多——还剩30场比赛，对手全是胜率五成或以下的球队。听起来像是通往季后赛的一条新铺好的路，是吧？
如果一个月前你把这样的赛程安排交给蓝鸟，他们会毫不犹豫地接受。过去几周是球队有趣的阶段，一支令人失望的球队在交易截止日后找到了新的生存和赢球方式。现在艰难的部分来了。
30场对阵五成胜率或以下球队的比赛听起来像是一个发射台，但蓝鸟这个赛季有什么是轻松得来的，有什么是合情合理的？这支球队一直让 Brett Bateman 和 Charles McAdoo 担任第一棒。现在是8月25日，Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 还没有在罗杰斯中心打出本垒打。你现在真的指望事情变得合乎逻辑吗？
第一个挑战：无牵无挂的垫底球队
有必要超越 "30场对阵胜率五成或以下球队" 这个口号来深入看问题，因为这句话并不能完全反映最近发生的事情。

以皇家为例，他们战绩58胜74负，位居美联中区垫底。这听起来并不那么有威胁性，但皇家已经赢下了最近八场比赛，刚刚以11-7击败老虎。这依然是 Bobby Witt Jr. 和 Jac Caglianone 的表演，但皇家正打得风生水起。他们的先发轮值投得很好，Craig Kimbrel 现在效力于他职业生涯第12支MLB球队，刚刚收获了生涯第441次救援成功。天哪，连 Salvador Perez 都在盗垒了。
蓝鸟将在这个主场系列赛与皇家交手三场，然后下周末前往堪萨斯城，开启一个包括造访守护者和运动家在内的三城客场之旅。
我们一直在说蓝鸟打得像是无牵无挂，但皇家是真的无牵无挂。在赛季末段，像皇家、运动家或红人这样的球队有些危险，尽管他们早已退出季后赛争夺。有了正确的核心和正确的教练，这样的球队可以打得轻松自由，如果他们在末段派出年轻潜力新秀体验大联盟，那又会增加一层未知因素。
蓝鸟必须避免打得和对手一样差，但我们已经看到这种引力有多强。
更大的挑战：美联外卡竞争中的球队
我们别假装这场争夺战中的其他球队在末段都是要30次对阵道奇。
多伦多的赛程确实较为有利，但大多数竞争者面对的赛程也差不多。蓝鸟接下来将与水手、守护者、金莺（两次）、老虎和游骑兵进行系列赛，这些都是这场争夺战中的核心球队。每晚、每个系列赛都会出现巨大的起伏。
关键因素在于动力。面对像运动家这样的球队，蓝鸟或许会遇到一支已无缘季后赛的球队，在某个夜晚他们不会全力使用牛棚。如果你已经完全无缘季后赛，为什么要让你的顶级后援投手四天里投三天？这是一个小优势、一个小因素，但在如此激烈的争夺中，这一切都非常重要。
在与真正的季后赛竞争者进行的另外18场比赛中，蓝鸟每晚都将面对对手的最佳状态。仅仅因为他们都是 "低于五成胜率" 几个胜场，并不意味着威胁会减小。
大问题：哪支球队能打出一波连胜？
现在不是为打出可持续、略高于五成胜率的棒球并以16胜14负收官而兴奋的时候。目前有七支球队有望争夺最后一个外卡名额，周二比赛开始前，他们之间差距都在4.5个胜场以内。这不是一场正常的外卡争夺战，因此需要有一支球队在最后阶段真正地爆发。
蓝鸟具备打出连胜的条件吗？他们的投手阵容很强，但这条打线能连续七八场比赛不 "打盹" 吗？他们本赛季最长的连胜只有四场，这并不让人鼓舞。这也是双城本赛季的最长连胜，但其他竞争者都打出过更长的连胜。
蓝鸟的先发轮值稳定，牛棚表现出色，防守在过去一个月再次成为全联盟最佳，但这些球队中会有一支依靠进攻爆发在最后30场比赛中赢下18或20场。
现在是一场冲刺。蓝鸟是冲刺型选手吗？

items.titleEn: Outfielder Casey makes Prospect Team of the Week
bodyEn: The Top 100 Prospects list isn't formulated to pick the players who will perform best in the Minor Leagues. It's a ranking that looks at which players project to have the most success in the Majors.
Of course, when tooled-up prospects also happen to put up big numbers, that's worthy of celebration.

This week marks the fourth time this season that at least four players on the Top 100 made a Prospect Team of the Week, with Walker Jenkins (MLB No. 15), Rainiel Rodriguez (MLB No. 18), Ralphy Velazquez (MLB No. 32) and Seaver King (MLB No. 71) leading the way.
To be eligible for the Pipeline Prospect Team of the Week, Minor League players must be ranked among their club's Top 30 prospects on Pipeline's lists. (Those in the Majors do not qualify.)
This is the Prospect Team of the Week for Aug. 17-23:
C: Rainiel Rodriguez, Springfield Cardinals (Double-A)Cardinals No. 1/MLB No. 18.583/.577/1.083, 5 G, 14-for-24, 3 HR, 3 2B, 9 RBI, 6 R, 0 BB, 2 K, 1 CS

Double-A has an impressive group of talented 19-year-olds -- including MLB's top two prospects in Jesús Made and Leo De Vries -- but none are hitting as well as Rodriguez. The Dominican Republic native has a 154 wRC+, 37 points higher than second-place De Vries, as he continues to blister hard line drives across the Texas League. Last week was more of the same as he extended his hitting streak to 14 games with a four-hit, two-homer performance on Sunday. Rodriguez's defense remains a work in progress -- he's also spending time at first base and DH -- but his right-handed power is not in question.
1B: Ralphy Velazquez, Columbus Clippers (Triple-A)Guardians No. 2/MLB No. 32.455/.500/1.273, 6 G, 10-for-22, 6 HR, 12 RBI, 8 R, 3 BB, 3 K

Nobody is hitting like Velazquez lately; his 14 homers in August are three more than any player in the Majors or Minors. In fact, he went deep 16 times in 20 games dating back to late July, and the only big leaguers to accomplish that are Barry Bonds, Sammy Sosa, Mark McGwire, Kyle Schwarber and Albert Belle. The 2023 first-rounder even delivered his first professional three-homer game on Saturday, which raised his OPS to .925 (compared to .707 before the roundtripper surge). Velazquez has made a Prospect Team of the Week previously in August 2025 and May 2026.
2B: JD Dix, Hillsboro Hops (High-A)D-backs No. 8.421/.522/.789, 5 G, 8-for-19, 1 HR, 1 3B, 2 2B, 5 RBI, 5 R, 4 BB, 5 K, 2 SB, 1 CS

The 35th pick in the 2024 Draft stands out more for his hit tool than his power, but he's been slugging more lately as he settles in at High-A. Over his past 10 games, he's collected extra bases on eight of 15 hits, which has contributed to a .996 OPS in August. The switch-hitter hit his lone homer of the week against a righty, which fits into his season-long trend of being more effective batting lefty (.255/.371/.440) than righty (.240/.309/.360). This is Dix's second Prospect Team of the Week appearance of the season after a hot stretch to end May.
3B: Rafe Perich, Frisco RoughRiders (Double-A)Rangers No. 19.556/.591/.944, 5 G, 10-for-18, 1 HR, 4 2B, 7 RBI, 7 R, 3 BB, 4 K, 1 SB

Perich is in the midst of a breakout season and leads all qualified Rangers Minor Leaguers in full-season ball with a .992 OPS. The switch-hitter has long been able to make hard contact, but it's coming more in bunches lately too, with four multihit performances last week, including a four-hit game to begin the series. After taking his lumps on defense last year and splitting his time between the infield corners to start the season, the 2024 seventh-rounder has been consistently playing third at a higher level the past two months.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
SS: Seaver King, Rochester Red Wings (Triple-A)Nationals No. 4/MLB No. 71.440/.548/1.000, 6 G, 11-for-25, 4 HR, 1 3B, 10 RBI, 9 R, 6 BB, 10 K, 3 SB

The Nationals are transitioning two-time All-Star CJ Abrams to second base, so could King become the solution at short in the nation's capital? He's doing his best to earn his first callup, the way he's swinging his bat. In 20 games since returning from a left oblique strain in July, the 2024 first-rounder is slashing .388/.490/.763 with eight homers. Six of those roundtrippers came in a six-game stretch, and he delivered his first four-hit game of the season last week to boot.
OF: Walker Jenkins, St. Paul Saints (Triple-A)Twins No. 1/MLB No. 15.500/.600/1.100, 5 G, 10-for-20, 4 HR, 7 RBI, 6 R, 5 BB, 3 K, 3 SB

Health has been the only thing holding "Captain America" back; since returning from a shoulder joint sprain in June, he's slashing .354/.426/.600 with 11 homers in 46 games. The 2023 fifth overall pick delivered a pair of two-homer games last week -- giving him three on the month -- and he's running more lately, with six steals (on eight attempts) in his past 11 games. This marks four straight seasons in which Jenkins has made a Prospect Team of the Week.
OF: Robert Calaz, Spokane Indians (High-A)Rockies No. 23.480/.536/1.000, 6 G, 12-for-25, 4 HR, 1 2B, 7 RBI, 8 R, 3 BB, 6 K, 1 SB

The Dominican Republic native went through quite a cold spell from mid-July to mid-August, going 4-for-54 with 21 K's, but he's producing once again after some time on the bench. The 20-year-old has a hit in eight straight games, including a four-hit performance to kick off the week and three homers in his past two games. Calaz's 31 percent strikeout rate is quite concerning after he whiffed just 25.9 and 23.6 percent the previous two seasons, but he has a ton of right-handed power -- and previously made a Prospect Team of the Week in July 2025.
OF: Jake Casey, Vancouver Canadians (High-A)Blue Jays No. 26.391/.444/1.043, 6 G, 9-for-23, 4 HR, 3 2B, 13 RBI, 7 R, 2 BB, 7 K, 2 SB

Just like his dad, three-time All-Star Sean, Jake Casey has promising potential in his left-handed swing. The 2025 15th-rounder missed two months after suffering a broken hamate in his season debut but has returned with plenty of impact -- which is no given after that particular injury. The younger Casey hit safely in all six games last series, with his first seven knocks all going for extra bases, as he delivered a pair of multihomer performances and raised his season OPS to .884.
LHP: Pierce Coppola, South Bend Cubs (High-A)Cubs No. 300-0, 0.00 ERA, 1 G, 1 GS, 5 IP, 0 H, 0 R, 0 ER, 2 BB, 7 K, 0.40 WHIP

Coppola keeps it simple -- at least, as simple as you can keep it out of a 6-foot-8 frame. The 2025 seventh-rounder utilizes just a low-90s fastball and upper-70s slider out of a low slot and is seeing if he can make that work as a starter. Since his promotion to High-A in July, he's given up zero earned runs in four of his seven starts, including his latest, in which he struck out seven across five hitless innings.
RHP: Argenis Cayama, San Jose Giants (Single-A)Giants No. 171-0, 0.00 ERA, 1 G, 1 GS, 5 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 0 ER, 0 BB, 9 K, 0.20 WHIP

The 19-year-old Venezuela native has impressive athleticism and feel for pitching given his age, enabling him to perform well in the lower Minors. He's coming off his best start of the year: five scoreless innings with nine strikeouts and just one hit allowed. The Giants have managed his innings in the second half, but Cayama has been very effective over his past 10 starts, with a 2.64 ERA and 31 strikeouts over 30 2/3 innings with just nine walks issued.
RP: Luis Perales, Rochester Red Wings (Triple-A)Nationals No. 121-0, 0.00 ERA, 2 G, 4 IP, 0 H, 0 R, 0 ER, 1 BB, 7 K, 0.25 WHIP

Perales was in the midst of an excellent first season in the Nationals organization after Washington acquired him from Boston for Jake Bennett, but he's looked even better since moving to the bullpen in his past three outings. The 6-foot righty has struck out 12 across six scoreless innings with two hits and two walks given up. Notably, he's throwing his changeup half the time after doing so less than a quarter of the time as a starter, and he's getting a whiff on 51.7 percent of swings on the pitch. He previously made a Prospect Team of the Week in June 2023 as a starter.
items.titleZh: 外野手Casey入选每周最佳新秀阵容
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟外野手Jake Casey单周4轰13打点，入选8月17-23日每周最佳新秀阵容。
bodyZh: 百大新秀名单并不是为了挑选在小联盟表现最好的球员。它是一个着眼于哪些球员有望在大联盟取得最大成功的排名。
当然，当天赋异禀的新秀也恰好打出亮眼数据时，这值得庆祝。
本周是本赛季第四次至少有四位百大新秀入选每周最佳新秀阵容，其中Walker Jenkins（MLB第15位）、Rainiel Rodriguez（MLB第18位）、Ralphy Velazquez（MLB第32位）和Seaver King（MLB第71位）领衔。
要获得Pipeline每周最佳新秀阵容的资格，小联盟球员必须在其俱乐部的Pipeline名单上排名前30位。（大联盟球员不符合资格。）
以下是8月17日至23日的每周最佳新秀阵容：
捕手：Rainiel Rodriguez，Springfield Cardinals（2A）红雀第1号/MLB第18位。打击三围 .583/.577/1.083，5场比赛，24打数14安打，3本垒打，3二垒安打，9打点，6得分，0保送，2三振，1盗垒被刺。

2A有一批令人印象深刻的19岁天才球员——包括MLB前两大新秀Jesús Made和Leo De Vries——但没有人像Rodriguez那样打得好。这位多米尼加共和国出身的球员wRC+达到154，比第二名的De Vries高出37分，他继续在得克萨斯联赛中击出强劲的平飞球。上周也是如此，他在周日打出四安打两本垒打，将连续安打场次延长到14场。Rodriguez的防守仍在进步中——他也在一垒和指定打击位置上场——但他的右打力量毫无悬念。
一垒手：Ralphy Velazquez，Columbus Clippers（3A）守护者第2号/MLB第32位。打击三围 .455/.500/1.273，6场比赛，22打数10安打，6本垒打，12打点，8得分，3保送，3三振。

近来没有人的打击表现像Velazquez这样火热；他在8月轰出14支本垒打，比大联盟或小联盟的任何球员都多出3支。事实上，自7月下旬以来，他在20场比赛中轰出16发，而大联盟中只有Barry Bonds、Sammy Sosa、Mark McGwire、Kyle Schwarber和Albert Belle做到过这一点。这位2023年首轮秀在周六甚至打出了职业生涯首个单场三响炮，这将他的OPS提升到.925（而在本垒打爆发前为.707）。Velazquez此前曾在2025年8月和2026年5月入选过每周最佳新秀阵容。
二垒手：JD Dix，Hillsboro Hops（高A）响尾蛇第8号。打击三围 .421/.522/.789，5场比赛，19打数8安打，1本垒打，1三垒安打，2二垒安打，5打点，5得分，4保送，5三振，2盗垒成功，1盗垒被刺。

2024年选秀第35顺位的Dix更以击球能力而非力量著称，但他在高A适应后近期长打增多。过去10场比赛中，他在15支安打中有8支是长打，这使他在8月的OPS达到.996。这位左右开弓打者本周唯一的本垒打是面对右投手轰出的，这符合他整个赛季的趋势——左打（.255/.371/.440）比右打（.240/.309/.360）更高效。这是Dix本赛季第二次入选每周最佳新秀阵容，此前他在5月底的一波火热表现后曾入选过。
三垒手：Rafe Perich，Frisco RoughRiders（2A）游骑兵第19号。打击三围 .556/.591/.944，5场比赛，18打数10安打，1本垒打，4二垒安打，7打点，7得分，3保送，4三振，1盗垒成功。
Perich正处于生涯突破赛季，他在完整赛季的棒球联赛中，以.992的OPS领先所有有资格的游骑兵小联盟球员。这位左右开弓打者一直能打出强劲的接触，但最近更是火力密集，上周有4场多安打表现，包括系列赛首战的四安打。在去年防守上吃了些苦头，以及本赛季初在内野两个角落分时上场后，这位2024年第七轮秀在过去两个月里一直以更高水平稳定镇守三垒。

游击手：Seaver King，Rochester Red Wings（3A）国民第4号/MLB第71位。打击三围 .440/.548/1.000，6场比赛，25打数11安打，4本垒打，1三垒安打，10打点，9得分，6保送，10三振，3盗垒成功。
国民队正在将两届全明星CJ Abrams移至二垒，那么King能否成为华盛顿特区游击位置的答案？他正用球棒努力争取首次升上大联盟。自7月从左斜肌拉伤中复出以来的20场比赛中，这位2024年首轮秀的打击三围为.388/.490/.763，并有8发本垒打。其中6发来自连续6场比赛，而且他上周还打出了本赛季首场四安打。
外野手：Walker Jenkins，St. Paul Saints（3A）双城第1号/MLB第15位。打击三围 .500/.600/1.100，5场比赛，20打数10安打，4本垒打，7打点，6得分，5保送，3三振，3盗垒成功。
健康一直是阻碍“美国队长”的唯一因素；自6月肩关节扭伤复出以来，他在46场比赛中打击三围为.354/.426/.600，并有11发本垒打。这位2023年第五顺位上周打出两场双响炮——本月已有三场——而且他最近跑动更多，过去11场比赛中6次盗垒（8次尝试）。这标志着Jenkins连续第四个赛季入选每周最佳新秀阵容。
外野手：Robert Calaz，Spokane Indians（高A）洛矶第23号。打击三围 .480/.536/1.000，6场比赛，25打数12安打，4本垒打，1二垒安打，7打点，8得分，3保送，6三振，1盗垒成功。
这位多米尼加共和国出身的球员在7月中旬至8月中旬经历了一段相当长的低潮期，54打数仅4安打，有21次三振，但在替补席休息一段时间后他再次拿出表现。这位20岁球员已连续8场有安打，包括本周开端的四安打，以及过去两场的三发本垒打。Calaz 31%的三振率相当令人担忧，此前两个赛季他的三振率分别只有25.9%和23.6%，但他拥有强大的右打力量——此前他曾在2025年7月入选过每周最佳新秀阵容。
外野手：Jake Casey，Vancouver Canadians（高A）蓝鸟第26号。打击三围 .391/.444/1.043，6场比赛，23打数9安打，4本垒打，3二垒安打，13打点，7得分，2保送，7三振，2盗垒成功。
和他的父亲、三届全明星球员Sean一样，Jake Casey的左打挥棒拥有令人期待的天赋。这位2025年第15轮秀在赛季首秀中遭遇钩状骨骨折后缺席了两个月，但复出后表现极具冲击力——这种伤病后并非总能如此。小Casey在上一系列赛全部六场比赛中都有安打，前七支安打全部是长打，他打出两场多本垒打的表现，将赛季OPS提升到.884。
左投手：Pierce Coppola，South Bend Cubs（高A）小熊第30号，0胜0负，0.00自责分率，1场出场，1场先发，5局投球，0安打，0失分，0自责分，2保送，7三振，0.40 WHIP。
Coppola保持简单——至少，对于6尺8寸的身材来说，你能保持的简单。这位2025年第七轮秀只使用低90英里时速的速球和上70英里时速的滑球，出手点较低，他正在检验能否以先发身份奏效。自7月升上高A以来，他在7场先发中有4场未失自责分，包括最近一场，五局无安打并送出7次三振。
右投手：Argenis Cayama，San Jose Giants（1A）巨人第17号，1胜0负，0.00自责分率，1场出场，1场先发，5局投球，1安打，0失分，0自责分，0保送，9三振，0.20 WHIP。
这位19岁的委内瑞拉球员拥有令人印象深刻的运动能力和与年龄不符的投球感觉，使他在低阶小联盟表现出色。他刚打出赛季最佳先发：五局无失分，9次三振，仅被敲1安打。巨人队在下半季控制了他的局数，但Cayama在过去10场先发中非常高效，自责分率2.64，30又2/3局中送出31次三振，仅投出9次保送。
后援投手：Luis Perales，Rochester Red Wings（3A）国民第12号，1胜0负，0.00自责分率，2场出场，4局投球，0安打，0失分，0自责分，1保送，7三振，0.25 WHIP。
Perales在华盛顿以Jake Bennett从波士顿换来后，正在国民队度过一个出色的首个赛季，但自从过去三次出场转入牛棚后，他看起来更好了。这位6尺右投在六局无失分中送出12次三振，仅被敲2安打和2保送。值得注意的是，他的变速球使用率达一半，而作为先发时使用率不到四分之一，并且他在这个球种上获得51.7%的挥空率。此前他曾在2023年6月作为先发入选过每周最佳新秀阵容。

items.titleEn: Two crucial areas where Toronto could close the gap in Wild Card race
bodyEn: This story was excerpted from Keegan Matheson's Blue Jays Beat newsletter. To read the full newsletter, click here. And subscribe to get it regularly in your inbox.
NEW YORK -- At this point in the season, there aren’t many secrets left.

The big stories are what they are, like Vladimir Guerrero Jr.’s year-long slump or the Blue Jays’ cruel run of pitching injuries dating back to Spring Training. As much as this organization would love to see a complete renaissance from Guerrero to play the role of savior, the next month is about small margins in an airtight race.
One play, one bounce or one bad habit could decide the AL Wild Card race. That’s why all of the Blue Jays seem to be talking the same way lately.
“We’re doing the little things right,” Dylan Cease said. “We’re playing fundamentally well. It feels like we’re in every game and we’ve got a shot at every game, which is where you want to be.”
Nathan Lukes, just a few minutes after Cease, had the same ideas.

“We’re doing more of the little things right,” Lukes said. “We’re going from first to third. The defense is looking way better. It’s just those little things like getting the bunt down, throwing to the right bases, eliminating the errors. It’s been fun.”

These are crucial. They aren’t flashy and none of these are as fun as Guerrero hitting a 465-foot home run, but they’re going to make all the difference, especially for a team with a certain affinity for playing one-run ballgames. There are two major areas where the Blue Jays could find those inches:

This team needs to hold runnersThis is a quiet weakness of the Blue Jays, and one they need to tighten up. Entering play Sunday, the Blue Jays had allowed 126 stolen bases, the most in Major League Baseball.

Brandon Valenzuela has a cannon attached to his right shoulder and Alejandro Kirk is no slouch, either, so it’s difficult to place much blame on the catchers. This means the Blue Jays’ pitching staff really, really needs to hold runners better than they have through the first five months of the season.

Cease has allowed 26 stolen bases. That’s the most in baseball, and while it’s softened by the fact that Cease escapes most jams, it’s still turning a walk into a free double at least once a start. Spencer Arrighetti is tied for fifth in the league with 20 allowed, too, even after missing some time.

This isn’t contagious, of course, and the Blue Jays do have some pitchers who do an excellent job controlling the running game, which will be a factor down the stretch. Trey Yesavage is unfortunately injured, but his quick, sudden delivery helped him hold opponents to just three stolen bases over 93 2/3 innings. Comparing his delivery to Cease’s, which is more deliberate as he glides powerfully down the mound, you can clearly see why opponents may target Cease more.

In the bullpen, Braydon Fisher is the ace when it comes to holding runners, and he’s got a knack for pickoff plays on top of it. Tyler Rogers has only allowed one steal in 61 appearances while Louis Varland has held opponents to five in 60 games, so the back end of this bullpen is solid enough.

The Rays and Yankees, could very well line up with the Blue Jays at some point in the postseason if they can sneak in, sit fourth and fifth in steals in MLB. That seems like an awfully dangerous weakness to be exploited on the big stage.

Lately? Some big defensive improvementsThe Blue Jays’ team-wide defensive metrics can be misleading. They rank second in team Fielding Run Value (+39), but so much of that value belongs to their catchers. When you sort it by just the defensive value Toronto’s infielders and outfielders provide, they slip to 10th.

August has felt so much sharper, though, and the numbers back it up. Since the start of the month, the Blue Jays are the No. 1 defense in baseball at +17 Fielding Runs Saved … and they stay No. 1 even when you remove the value of their catchers.

This is a credit to regulars like Ernie Clement sharpening up their defense along with the addition of Brett Bateman, who profiles as an excellent defensive center fielder. Andrés Giménez has been brilliant, too, having his best defensive month of the season. He’s tied for fourth among all MLB players in Fielding Run Value.
Once again, if the Blue Jays want to win 2-1 and 3-2 ballgames, they need to play elite defensive baseball.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟缩小外卡差距的两大关键
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟需控制对手盗垒并提升防守，以在外卡竞争中占据优势。
bodyZh: 本文摘自Keegan Matheson的《蓝鸟Beat》通讯。要阅读完整通讯，请点击此处。并订阅以便定期在收件箱中获取。
纽约——赛季进行到当前阶段，已经没有太多秘密了。
大新闻就是这样，比如Vladimir Guerrero Jr.持续一年的低迷，或者蓝鸟从春训开始就不断遭遇的严重投手伤病。尽管球队非常希望看到Guerrero全面复苏来扮演救世主，但接下来的一个月是在激烈竞争中争夺微小优势。
一次关键发挥、一次弹跳或一个坏习惯都可能决定美国联盟外卡争夺。这就是为什么最近所有蓝鸟球员似乎都在说同样的话。
“我们正在把小事做好，”Dylan Cease说道。“我们的基本功执行得很好。感觉我们每场比赛都能咬住，每一场都有机会，这是你想处的位置。”
Nathan Lukes在Cease之后几分钟也表达了同样的想法。
“我们做了更多正确的小事，”Lukes说。“我们能够从一垒跑到三垒。防守看起来好多了。就是那些小事，比如把触击做好、传对垒位、避免失误。这很有趣。”
这些至关重要。它们并不华丽，也不像Guerrero打出465英尺本垒打那样有趣，但它们将产生决定性的影响，尤其是对于一支特别爱打一分差比赛的球队。蓝鸟有两个主要领域可以找到那几英寸的优势：
这支球队需要控制对方跑者。这是蓝鸟一个隐蔽的弱点，也是他们需要加强的地方。进入周日的比赛，蓝鸟已经让对手偷垒126次，这是大联盟最多的。
Brandon Valenzuela的右肩就像一门大炮，Alejandro Kirk也不逊色，所以很难把太多责任归咎于捕手。这意味着蓝鸟的投手群真的、真的需要比本赛季前五个月更好地控制跑者。
Cease已经让对手偷垒26次，这是全联盟最多的。虽然这被Cease能化解大多数危机的事实所缓和，但这仍然让一次保送变成一次免费的垒包推进，至少每场先发一次。Spencer Arrighetti以20次让对手偷垒并列联盟第五，尽管他缺席了一段时间。
这当然不会传染，而且蓝鸟确实有一些投手在控制对方进攻方面做得非常出色，这将是冲刺阶段的一个因素。Trey Yesavage不幸受伤，但他快速、突然的出手让他在93 2/3局中只让对手偷垒三次。将他的出手与Cease相比，Cease在强力向本垒板滑行时出手更加从容，你可以清楚地看到为什么对手可能更针对Cease。
在牛棚中，Braydon Fisher是控制跑者的王牌，而且他还擅长牵制。Tyler Rogers在61次出场中只让对手偷垒一次，Louis Varland在60场比赛中让对手偷垒五次，所以牛棚后端足够稳固。
光芒和洋基，如果蓝鸟能挤进季后赛，他们很可能在某个时刻与蓝鸟相遇，这两支球队的偷垒数在MLB排名第四和第五。这似乎是一个非常危险的弱点，可能会在大舞台上被利用。
最近怎样？防守有了重大的进步。蓝鸟全队的防守指标可能具有误导性。他们在球队防守跑动值（+39）上排名第二，但其中很大一部分价值属于捕手。如果只看多伦多内野手和外野手提供的防守价值，他们会滑落到第十。
不过，8月份感觉要犀利得多，而且数据也证明了这一点。自本月初以来，蓝鸟的防守以+17的守备节省分排名全联盟第一……即使去掉捕手的价值，他们仍然保持第一。
这要归功于Ernie Clement等常规球员提升了防守，以及球队加入了Brett Bateman，他被视为一名出色的防守型中外野手。Andrés Giménez也很出色，打出了他本赛季个人最好的防守月份。他在防守跑动值上与MLB所有球员并列第四。
再说一次，如果蓝鸟想赢下2-1和3-2这样的一分差比赛，他们就需要打出精英级的防守棒球。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays, Cubs set to face off in 2027 Little League Classic
bodyEn: The Toronto Blue Jays and the Chicago Cubs will headline the 2027 “MLB Little League Classic presented by New York Life,” in Williamsport, Pennsylvania, Major League Baseball announced on Sunday night. The announcement was made by Commissioner of Baseball Robert D. Manfred Jr., who joined the ESPN broadcast during tonight’s 2026 Little League Classic between the Atlanta Braves and Milwaukee Brewers. The national game, which will be held on Thursday, August 19, 2027, will air exclusively on ESPN and in Canada on Sportsnet at 7:10 p.m. (ET)/6:10 p.m. (CT). The special event, which will mark the 10th year of the annual showcase, hosted in connection with the Little League Baseball World Series presented by T-Mobile, will also be available on the ESPN App.

In keeping with the tradition of this annual event, Major Leaguers from both the Blue Jays and the Cubs will attend Little League World Series games earlier in the day on August 19, demonstrating their commitment to helping grow the game at the youth level and engage with young fans. Later that evening, Little League World Series players and their families will fill Journey Bank Ballpark at Historic Bowman Field for the Little League Classic game. It will mark the first time that the contest will be played on Thursday, headlining ESPN’s slate of baseball that day, which will spotlight Little League all the way up to the Majors. The Blue Jays will be the home team in the matchup.

Major League Baseball launched the Little League Classic in August 2017, first featuring the Pittsburgh Pirates and the St. Louis Cardinals. The ensuing events included the New York Mets and the Philadelphia Phillies in 2018; the Pirates and Chicago Cubs in 2019; the Cleveland Guardians and Los Angeles Angels in 2021; the Baltimore Orioles and Boston Red Sox in 2022; the Washington Nationals and Phillies in 2023; the New York Yankees and Detroit Tigers in 2024; the Mets and Seattle Mariners in 2025; and the Braves and Brewers in 2026.

A bucket-list destination for fans of every age, the Little League Baseball® World Series is held each August in Williamsport, Pennsylvania, the birthplace of the organization that is trusted by millions of parents around the world. Every year, 20 teams of 10- to 12-year-old baseball players from around the globe come together to compete for the championship banner, while forging lifelong memories. More than 70 players have appeared in the Little League Baseball World Series and played in the Majors, including 10 who have appeared in a regular season game in 2026: Cody Bellinger (NYY, 2007); Brett Callahan (DET, 2013); Michael Conforto (CHC, 2004); Angel Genao (CLE, 2017); Randal Grichuk (CWS, 2003-04); Scott Kingery (CHC, 2006); Yohel Pozo (BAL, 2009); Ceddanne Rafaela (BOS, 2012); Jeferson Quero (MIL, 2015); and Matt Wilkinson (SF, 2015). Conforto, who has appeared in 87 games for the Cubs this season, is one of three players to appear in the Little League Baseball World Series, Men’s College World Series and Major League Baseball’s World Series, joining Jason Varitek and Ed Vosberg.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟小熊将在2027年少棒经典赛交手
items.summaryZh: MLB宣布，蓝鸟和小熊将在2027年8月19日的少棒经典赛中交手。
bodyZh: 多伦多蓝鸟与芝加哥小熊将领衔2027年“纽约人寿呈现的MLB少棒经典赛”，比赛将在宾夕法尼亚州威廉斯波特举行。美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）于周日晚上宣布了这一消息。该消息由棒球专员小罗伯特·D·曼弗雷德宣布，他在今晚亚特兰大勇士与密尔沃基酿酒人的2026年少棒经典赛的ESPN转播中加入了节目。这场全国性比赛将于2027年8月19日星期四举行，由ESPN独家播出，加拿大地区由Sportsnet于东部时间晚上7:10/中部时间6:10播出。这一特别活动将是该年度展示赛事的第十届，与T-Mobile呈现的少棒联盟世界大赛合作举办，也将在ESPN应用上播出。
遵循这一年度赛事的传统，蓝鸟和小熊的大联盟球员将于8月19日白天前往观看少棒联盟世界大赛的比赛，展示他们对帮助青少年层面发展棒球运动以及与小球迷互动的承诺。当天晚上，少棒联盟世界大赛的球员及其家人将涌进历史悠久的鲍曼球场内的旅程银行棒球场，观看少棒经典赛。这将是该赛事首次在星期四举行，作为ESPN当天棒球转播计划的重头戏，将聚焦从少棒联盟到大联盟的棒球。蓝鸟将是本场比赛的主队。
美国职业棒球大联盟于2017年8月推出少棒经典赛，首届比赛由匹兹堡海盗对阵圣路易斯红雀。随后的赛事包括：2018年纽约大都会对阵费城费城人；2019年海盗对阵芝加哥小熊；2021年克利夫兰守护者对阵洛杉矶天使；2022年巴尔的摩金莺对阵波士顿红袜；2023年华盛顿国民对阵费城人；2024年纽约洋基对阵底特律老虎；2025年大都会对阵西雅图水手；2026年勇士对阵酿酒人。

少棒联盟世界大赛是各个年龄段球迷的必去目的地，每年八月在宾夕法尼亚州威廉斯波特举行，这里是该组织的诞生地，受到全球数百万家长的信任。每年，来自全球的20支由10至12岁棒球运动员组成的队伍齐聚一堂，争夺冠军旗帜，同时留下终身难忘的回忆。已有超过70名球员曾参加少棒联盟世界大赛并随后登上大联盟，其中包括10名在2026年常规赛出场过的球员：Cody Bellinger（纽约洋基，2007年）；Brett Callahan（底特律老虎，2013年）；Michael Conforto（芝加哥小熊，2004年）；Angel Genao（克利夫兰守护者，2017年）；Randal Grichuk（芝加哥白袜，2003-04年）；Scott Kingery（芝加哥小熊，2006年）；Yohel Pozo（巴尔的摩金莺，2009年）；Ceddanne Rafaela（波士顿红袜，2012年）；Jeferson Quero（密尔沃基酿酒人，2015年）；以及Matt Wilkinson（旧金山巨人，2015年）。Conforto本赛季已为小熊出战87场比赛，他是仅有的三位先后参加少棒联盟世界大赛、大学世界大赛和大联盟世界大赛的球员之一，另两位是Jason Varitek和Ed Vosberg。

items.titleEn: Gassed 'pen can't escape jam as Blue Jays wrap .500 AL East swing
bodyEn: NEW YORK -- The Blue Jays survived this road trip against the Rays and Yankees, but when they land home in Toronto tonight, surviving will no longer be enough.

Sunday’s 8-3 loss at Yankee Stadium gave the Blue Jays a 3-3 road trip against their American League East rivals, but they’re now facing a much softer schedule over their final 30 games. With Toronto now sitting one game out of the final AL Wild Card spot in a crowded race, the clock is ticking.
This is what mattered most on Sunday:

1. A bullpen running on fumesThe sixth inning captured what this bullpen has been up against in 2026 when Braydon Fisher was thrown into the toughest assignment a reliever can get: No outs, bases loaded.

Fisher was one pitch away from pulling off the great escape, but he walked in the go-ahead run. Mason Fluharty picked it up after that and allowed a two-run single, breaking the game open, with all three of those runs charged to starter José Soriano.

The Blue Jays’ relievers have been solid this season, many of them absolutely excellent. Fisher’s 63 appearances tie him for fourth in Major League Baseball this season, and he continues to give manager John Schneider every reason to trust him in these big spots in the seventh or eighth, a great option in front of Tyler Rogers and Louis Varland.

Fluharty actually tops the league, with Sunday being his 69th appearance. The rubber-armed lefty might be the most underrated piece of this bullpen, given his 3.63 ERA paired with constant availability. The scene in the sixth inning Sunday, with both Fisher and Fluharty thrown into a messy inning that was not of their own making, was unfortunately all too fitting.
2. An ugly ending from SorianoWe’re seeing bursts of Soriano, but still not his full, dominant self.
Soriano settled into a very nice groove after allowing two runs in the second, but he seemed to run out of gas when he loaded the bases in the sixth inning on his 100th pitch.

Soriano has put together some nice outings since coming over from the Angels in a major move at the Trade Deadline, but soon enough, we’ll see him fully unleashed with something like six innings of one-run ball and eight strikeouts. Remember, it was Soriano who opened 2026 by allowing just one run over his first six starts (a 0.24 ERA) with the Angels. He can give you an old-fashioned quality start, but he’s also capable of true dominance.

3. One big thing… Hitting with runners in scoring positionIf the Blue Jays were hitting for power, this wouldn’t matter nearly as much. They’re not, though, which makes it absolutely necessary for them to hit with runners in scoring position. Two singles require a third single to drag a run across. This is how they fared in this series against the Yankees:
• Friday’s 3-1 loss: 1-for-14• Saturday’s 4-3 win: 4-for-18• Sunday’s 8-3 loss: 1-for-9

If we were still in April or May, it would be easier to write this off as a matter of small sample sizes, but it’s far too late for that. It’s no secret that the Blue Jays are a high-contact team that lacks power, so opposing pitchers haven’t needed to pitch scared. There’s clearly something in Toronto’s approach that needs improving here, and if power isn’t going to ride in and save the day, the Jays will need to find a more efficient brand of small ball, which we’ve seen some more encouraging flashes of lately.
Without power, though, every margin is so thin. This only gets more difficult in the postseason, too, where the Blue Jays would be facing No. 1 and No. 2 starters.
items.titleZh: 牛棚力竭难解满垒危机 蓝鸟客场之旅五成胜率收官
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟客场之旅3胜3负，落后外卡一胜场。牛棚疲惫难解危机，得点圈打击成短板。
bodyZh: 纽约——蓝鸟在与光芒和洋基的客场之旅中撑了过来，但今晚当他们飞抵多伦多时，仅仅撑过来已不再足够。
周日他们在洋基球场以8-3落败，这使得蓝鸟这次面对美联东区对手的客场之旅战绩为3胜3负。但他们接下来最后30场比赛的赛程要轻松不少。多伦多目前身处拥挤的竞争行列，落后美联外卡最后一席一个胜场，时间正一分一秒地流逝。
以下是周日比赛中最值得关注的几点：
1. 牛棚力竭 第六局集中展现了蓝鸟牛棚在2026年所面临的困境：Braydon Fisher 被推上救援投手最艰巨的岗位——无人出局，满垒。
Fisher本可以再投一个好球就全身而退，但他却保送了超前分。随后Mason Fluharty接手投球，被击出两分打点的一垒安打，让比赛被彻底打开，这三分的失分都记在先发投手José Soriano账上。
蓝鸟的后援投手本赛季表现稳定，其中许多人相当出色。Fisher本赛季已出场63次，与大联盟并列第四。他继续给主教练John Schneider充分理由在第七或第八局的关键时刻信任他，是在Tyler Rogers和Louis Varland之前登场的绝佳选择。
Fluharty其实位居全联盟之首，周日已是他本赛季第69次出赛。这位铁臂左投可能是牛棚中最被低估的一环，他的自责分率3.63且随时可以上阵。周日的第六局，Fisher和Fluharty都被卷入一个并非自己造成的混乱局面，不幸的是，这一幕实在太应景了。
2. Soriano的糟糕收尾 我们能看到Soriano偶有闪光，但仍未展现出他完全统治力的自我。
Soriano在第二局失掉两分后迅速进入状态，但第六局投到第100球时他让对手攻占满垒，此后似乎油箱耗尽。
自从在交易截止日通过一笔重磅交易从天使队加盟以来，Soriano已经打出几场不错的比赛，但很快我们就会看到他完全爆发，比如六局只失一分送出八次三振。别忘了，正是Soriano在2026年效力天使时，前六场先发仅失一分（自责分率0.24）。他能给你一场老派的优质先发，但也能够真正统治比赛。
3. 重要的一点……得点圈打击 如果蓝鸟有长打火力，这个问题就不那么重要了。但他们没有，因此必须在得点圈有人时打出安打。两支一垒安打可能还不够，还需要第三支才能把跑者拖回本垒。以下就是他们与洋基这个系列赛的表现：
• 周五3-1告负：14打数1安打 • 周六4-3获胜：18打数4安打 • 周日8-3告负：9打数1安打
如果我们还处在四月或五月，或许可以把这归结为样本量太小，但现在说这个已经太晚了。众所周知，蓝鸟是一支强调击球率但缺少长打的球队，因此对方投手不必投得畏首畏尾。很明显，多伦多的进攻方式需要在这方面做出改进。如果长打不会站出来拯救球队，蓝鸟就需要找到更有效的小球进攻模式，而最近我们也看到了一些令人鼓舞的闪光点。
但没有长打火力，每一分的余量都太薄了。到了季后赛，这只会变得更加困难，届时蓝鸟将要面对对方的一号和二号先发投手。

items.titleEn: Toronto's no-hit drought continues, but signs of growth abound for Cease
bodyEn: NEW YORK -- One day, Dylan Cease will pull up a chair to Dave Stieb’s table.

No-hitters are mythical in Toronto. It has been nearly 36 years since Stieb finally recorded the first and only no-hitter in Blue Jays history, and for 36 years, pitchers have shown up on Stieb’s doorstep. A few of them have even knocked on the door, but that lock has never turned.

This time, Cease lugged his no-no through 6 2/3 innings Saturday at Yankee Stadium. It wasn’t nearly as clean, dominant or dramatic as the bid he carried into the ninth inning in San Francisco in July, but each of these flickers feels like something we’ll be referencing at some point down the road during Cease’s contract. It’s a cruel tradition in this organization that all of the greats have gone through.

“It feels like this happens every time he steps on the mound. The guy is unbelievable,” said Nathan Lukes, whose solo shot in the eighth was the eventual game-winner in a 4-3 victory over the Yankees. “It’s special what he’s doing this year. Being able to play behind him makes this even more special.”

Even the great Stieb, who finally reached the mountaintop on Sept. 2, 1990, suffered so many heartbreaks along the way. He originally lost a perfect game and two no-hitters in 1988 and ‘89, all three ending with two outs in the ninth inning. Roy Halladay, Brandon Morrow and Dustin McGowan have all lost no-hitters in the ninth inning, too, and Bowden Francis had two heartbreaks in late 2024.

This individual bid will be forgotten by next week, but it adds another chapter to a season that has become undeniable. Cease’s five walks muddied the waters Saturday, but he still held the Yankees to just one run over his 6 2/3 innings with eight strikeouts, lowering his ERA to 2.37. It’s down to Cease and Cam Schlittler for the American League Cy Young Award, and at this point, it’s close enough to call a dead heat.

“He’s been doing this all year,” Vladimir Guerrero Jr. said through interpreter Hector Lebron. “This is the second or third game where he’s taken it late into the game. What else can I say about him? Every day he’s out there, he gives us all that he has.”

Cease has been a road warrior, too. The lone run allowed ended Cease’s road scoreless streak at 42 innings, the second-longest road scoreless streak in at least the Expansion Era (since 1961). That trailed only 2004-05 Roger Clemens at 48 1/3 innings.

Cease is a workhorse, too, going over 100 pitches in 11 of his past 12 starts. Cease feels like the type of pitcher with big stuff who is, in 2026, getting shortened up to 95 pitches. He’s bucking the trend, though, a little old school sprinkled on top of such a modern pitcher.
“I feel pretty good,” Cease said. “It’s August, so I’m definitely grinding a little bit, but I’m able to take the ball, and that’s all that really matters.”

This is what Toronto dreamed of when it signed Cease to a seven-year, $210 million deal this past offseason. That deal wasn’t without its risks, as the Blue Jays were betting on Cease’s elite upside and trusting they could work with him to avoid the “down” years that have been peppered in. It has worked brilliantly.

Cease craves growth. He’s a pitching savant who talks like he owes this organization for the belief it has put in him. He knows how good he is, but he also knows that consistency has been his only downfall over the years. At times, he still sounds like a prospect who has just been called up, so certain that he’s about to make “the jump” and unlock a new level of himself.
“This year has been the biggest jump in development I’ve had in a long time,” Cease said. “That’s been a lot of fun and really exciting.”

Cease has 209 strikeouts now, and if things stay on turn, he could make six more starts this regular season. No one might ever reach Clemens’ club records for strikeouts in a single season (292 in 1997 and 271 in ‘98), but Cease has a clear path to the third most in franchise history. That’s currently held by Robbie Ray with 248 in his AL Cy Young season (‘21), just 39 away for Cease.
If Cease keeps pitching like this, he might join Clemens and Ray in the Cy Young club, too.
items.titleZh: 多伦多无安打荒延续，但Cease成长迹象明显
items.summaryZh: Cease投6 2/3局无安打，蓝鸟4-3胜洋基，多伦多无安打荒延续。
bodyZh: 纽约——总有一天，Dylan Cease会拉把椅子，坐到Dave Stieb的桌旁。
无安打比赛在多伦多是个神话。自从Stieb终于投出蓝鸟队史第一个也是唯一一个无安打比赛以来，已经将近36年。在这36年里，投手们纷纷来到Stieb的门前，有些人甚至敲了门，但那扇锁从未转动。
这一次，Cease在周六的洋基球场将无安打比赛扛到了6 2/3局。这远不如7月在旧金山投进第九局的那次干净、强势或戏剧性，但每一次这样的闪光，都像是我们会在Cease合同期内某个时刻提到的事情。这是这支球队中所有伟大球员都经历过的残酷传统。
“感觉每次他踏上投手丘都会发生这种事。这家伙令人难以置信，”Nathan Lukes说道，他在第八局的阳春炮最终成为4-3战胜洋基比赛中的制胜球。“他今年所做的很特别。能在他身后守备让这一切更加特别。”
即便是伟大的Stieb，最终在1990年9月2日登顶，但一路上也经历了那么多心碎。他曾在1988年和’89年先后错失一场完全比赛和两场无安打比赛，这三场都在第九局两人出局时功亏一篑。Roy Halladay、Brandon Morrow和Dustin McGowan也都在第九局丢掉过无安打比赛，Bowden Francis在2024年末则经历了两次心碎。
这次个人的尝试下周就会被遗忘，但它为本已无可否认的赛季增添了又一个篇章。Cease周六的5次保送让局面变得混乱，但他仍然在6 2/3局中仅让洋基得到1分，并送出8次三振，自责分率降至2.37。美国联盟赛扬奖的争夺现在只剩Cease和Cam Schlittler，而且目前两人接近到可以说是不分上下。
“他整个赛季都是这样，”Vladimir Guerrero Jr.通过翻译Hector Lebron说道。“这是他第二次或第三次投到比赛后段了。我还能说他什么呢？他每天上场都会付出全部。”
Cease也是一位客场战士。那唯一一分结束了他连续42局的客场无失分纪录，这是扩张时代（1961年以来）至少第二长的客场无失分连续局数。仅次于2004-05赛季的Roger Clemens的48 1/3局。
Cease也是一名耐投型投手，过去12场先发中有11场投球数超过100球。Cease给人的感觉是那种有强大球威的投手，在2026年这个时代，通常这种投手会被缩短到95球左右。但他逆势而行，在这样一位现代投手身上还带了一点老派风格。
“我感觉很好，”Cease说。“现在是8月，所以我确实有些挣扎，但我还能出赛，这才是最重要的。”
这正是多伦多在上个休赛期以7年2.1亿美元合同签下Cease时所梦想的。这笔交易并非没有风险，蓝鸟押注的是Cease的顶级潜力，并相信他们能与他合作避免那些不时出现的“低迷”赛季。事实证明这非常成功。
Cease渴望成长。他是一位投球天才，说起话来像是因为球队对他的信任而有所亏欠。他知道自己有多出色，但他也知道稳定性是多年来他唯一的弱点。有时，他听起来仍像一个刚被升上大联盟的潜力新秀，如此确信自己即将实现“飞跃”，开启新的境界。
“今年是我长期以来进步最大的一年，”Cease说。“这非常有趣，也令人兴奋。”
Cease目前已有209次三振，如果轮值安排不变，他还能在本赛季例行赛再先发6场。可能没有人能触及Clemens在队史单季三振纪录（1997年的292次和’98年的271次），但Cease有一条清晰的道路去冲击队史第三多。这一纪录目前由Robbie Ray在2021赛季（他的美联赛扬赛季）保持，为248次，Cease距离它只有39次。
如果Cease继续这样投下去，他或许也能加入Clemens和Ray的行列，成为赛扬奖得主。
items.author: Keegan Matheson

items.titleEn: Just how they drew it up: Cease shines, offense does just enough
bodyEn: NEW YORK -- This feels like the Blue Jays’ blueprint now, a clean-and-tidy game where the pitching stars and the offense chips away.

The 4-3 win over New York at Yankee Stadium pulls the Blue Jays (64-67) to within one game of the final American League Wild Card spot, a game of musical chairs that will continue later tonight when several other contenders are in action.
This is what mattered most:

1. Cease lands his Cy Young counterpunchThis start captured every possible version of Dylan Cease, didn’t it? There were five walks and far too many at-bats that went deep, which drove up Cease’s pitch count, but he was nearly unhittable.

Once again, Cease teased us with a run at a no-hitter, this one carrying through 6 2/3 innings against the Yankees. He would have needed the bullpen’s help either way, but these runs are becoming part of the routine with Cease, who lowered his ERA to 2.37 with the performance.

This comes just one day after Cam Schlittler beat the Blue Jays with six innings of one-run ball, the two AL Cy Young favorites going blow for blow once again. Schlittler still has the lower ERA (2.16) over more innings (158 to 144 1/3), but Cease’s strikeout total -- an AL-best 209 -- is overwhelming. This still feels like a race so tight that one blow-up outing … or one no-hitter … could completely decide the voting down the stretch.

2. Breaking up all those singlesOne big swing and a slow jog looked good on Nathan Lukes, didn’t it? His home run in the eighth was a breath of fresh air and some much-needed insurance after the Yankees finally showed some life.

Otherwise, the Blue Jays mostly stuck to their offensive identity of stacking up singles. It’s working, but how sustainable is this? In the postseason, when you’re facing the best pitchers in baseball, can Toronto still string together 10 singles to win a low-scoring game? That still sounds like a problem for another day, but Saturday afternoon, it worked again.

This style of baseball isn’t impossible to win with. Just look at the Rays, whom we tend to hold up as the model organization for small ball. Tampa Bay does it with speed on the bases, though, which isn’t something the Blue Jays have throughout their lineup.

Right now, this offensive style is working because the Blue Jays’ pitching has been sensational. When Cease pitches like this, you don’t need much offense at all, but this offense still needs to show more of what we saw down in St. Petersburg, when it was driving the baseball and leaving the yard. By October, that’s downright necessary. For the next month, it would just make things a whole lot easier.
3. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. returns to the lineupWhether you’re a believer in Guerrero or a pessimist, you saw what you were looking for Saturday in his return from the seven-day concussion IL.

There were some good swings, like a 110.2 mph single into left-center in the third, which looked more like the “real” Vladdy he has been searching for all season. Then, there were some pitches taken over the heart of the plate and a groundout with the bases loaded in the fourth, which Jazz Chisholm Jr. bobbled but still had plenty of time to make the play on Guerrero coming down the line.

The song remains the same with Guerrero. This team desperately needs him, and if Guerrero were performing to an .850 OPS, the Blue Jays would already be sitting comfortably in one of those Wild Card spots.
items.titleZh: 蓝图成真：希斯闪耀，进攻恰到好处
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟客场险胜洋基，距外卡仅差一场。
bodyZh: 纽约——这感觉就像是蓝鸟现在的蓝图，一场干净利落的比赛，投手唱主角，进攻慢慢磨。
在扬基球场以4比3战胜纽约后，蓝鸟（64胜67负）距离美国联盟最后一张外卡席位只差一场。这场抢椅子游戏将在今晚晚些时候继续，届时其他几支竞争者也将登场。
以下是最重要的几点：
1. 希斯打出赛扬奖反击战这场比赛展现了迪伦·希斯的每一种可能，不是吗？有五次保送，太多打席拖得很深，导致希斯的用球数上升，但他几乎无法被击出安打。
希斯再次让我们看到他冲击无安打比赛的跑动，这一次对洋基投了6又2/3局。无论怎样他都需要牛棚的帮助，但这些表现正成为希斯的常规操作，他凭借这场表现将自责分率降至2.37。
就在一天前，卡姆·施利特用六局失一分的表现击败了蓝鸟，这两位美国联盟赛扬奖热门人选再次针锋相对。施利特的自责分率仍然更低（2.16），投球局数也更多（158局对144又1/3局），但希斯的三振数——美联最佳的209次——令人印象深刻。这仍然像是一场竞争激烈的竞赛，一次崩盘……或一场无安打比赛……都可能完全决定接下来的投票方向。
2. 打破一堆一垒安打一次大挥棒和慢跑看起来对内森·卢克斯来说很好，不是吗？他在第八局的本垒打是一股新鲜空气，也是在洋基终于展现出一些活力之后急需的保险分。
除此之外，蓝鸟大多坚持了他们堆积一垒安打的进攻风格。这很有效，但可持续性如何？在季后赛面对最好的投手时，多伦多还能靠连续10支一垒安打赢下低比分比赛吗？这听起来仍是日后要解决的问题，但周六下午，这再次奏效了。
这种棒球风格不是不可能赢球。看看光芒队，我们常常把他们视为小球风格的组织典范。但坦帕湾依靠的是跑垒速度，这不是蓝鸟整个阵容都具备的。
目前，这种进攻风格之所以有效，是因为蓝鸟的投球表现出色。当希斯这样投球时，你根本不需要太多进攻，但这条进攻线仍然需要展现出更多我们在圣彼得堡看到的表现——把球打远，打出本垒打。到了十月，那是绝对必要的。在未来一个月里，那会让事情变得容易得多。
3. 小弗拉迪米尔·格雷罗回归阵容无论你是格雷罗的信徒还是悲观者，周六他在七天脑震荡伤病名单中复出的表现，让你看到了你想看的东西。
有一些好的挥棒，比如第三局一支110.2英里/时的中左外野一垒安打，看起来更像他整个赛季都在寻找的“真正的”弗拉迪。然后，也有几球在好球带中央被放掉，第四局满垒时打出滚地球出局，爵士·奇泽姆二世虽然接球失误，但在格雷罗沿一垒线跑动时仍有足够时间完成防守。
格雷罗的情况没有改变。这支球队迫切需要他，如果格雷罗能打出.850的上垒加长打率，蓝鸟应该已经舒适地坐在其中一个外卡席位上了。

items.titleEn: Vlad Jr. returns from IL as Blue Jays continue pivotal series vs. Yanks
bodyEn: NEW YORK -- Heading into their biggest series of the season against the Yankees, it sounds like the Blue Jays will have Vladimir Guerrero Jr. back in the lineup for Game 2 on Saturday.

At this point of the season, every series is the Blue Jays’ biggest, but there’s a scorching spotlight on this one after they took two of three from the AL East-leading Rays and continue to chase a Wild Card spot that looked completely unlikely just a few weeks ago.

Guerrero has been on the seven-day concussion IL since last weekend, when he collided with Yankees shortstop George Lombard Jr. on an awkward play at third base. Lombard’s left knee and thigh collided hard with Guerrero’s head, and while he immediately reported concussion symptoms, Blue Jays manager John Schneider says that Guerrero has since cleared all necessary testing and is expected back in the lineup Saturday.
“He felt good. These last couple of days, even before he left to play in Clearwater, [Fla.], he was feeling good,” Schneider said. "He’s feeling normal, so that’s a good thing.”

That Clearwater appearance was a blast from the past for Guerrero, rehabbing with the Single-A Dunedin squad he starred with in 2017. That team was stacked with top prospects, from Guerrero to Bo Bichette, Cavan Biggio and Danny Jansen. The manager? A young Schneider.
Guerrero doubled and walked twice in his rehab game Thursday, which was all the Blue Jays needed to see.

There’s hope within the organization that this recent stint on the IL, unfortunate as it’s been, could also allow Guerrero to rest up the rest of his body and come back fresher. He’s dealt with nagging back issues this season along with some hamstring issues, but he is rarely one to miss a game. As long as Guerrero is fully past this concussion -- which Schneider takes very seriously after being diagnosed with seven during his own Minor League catching career -- a fresh return to the lineup could help drag him out of this season-long slump.

So far, nothing’s had the power to do that. Guerrero is batting .263 with just seven home runs and a .693 OPS over 115 games. He hasn’t hit a home run at Rogers Centre this season, either, the strangest stat of all in a season that’s been impossible to explain.

Schneider has spent the past decade of his career believing in Guerrero, though, all the way back to their days in Dunedin, Fla., together. There’s been no indication that the Blue Jays will move Guerrero from his usual third spot in the lineup, and if Toronto is really going to take a run at this postseason, it needs to be Guerrero back out in front, leading the charge.
items.titleZh: 小弗拉德伤愈复出，蓝鸟迎战洋基关键系列赛
items.summaryZh: 小弗拉德·格雷罗将复出，助蓝鸟对阵洋基队。
bodyZh: 纽约——在即将迎来与洋基本赛季最关键的系列赛之际，蓝鸟队似乎将在周六的第二场比赛中让小弗拉基米尔·格雷罗重返先发阵容。
赛季进行到这个阶段，每个系列赛对蓝鸟来说都是最重要的，但在他们从美联东区领先的光芒队手中拿下三场中的两场后，这个系列赛受到了极大的关注，而他们仍在追逐几周前看起来几乎不可能的季后赛外卡席位。
格雷罗自上周末与洋基游击手乔治·隆巴德二世在三垒的一次意外碰撞后，一直待在七天脑震荡伤病名单上。隆巴德的左膝和大腿与格雷罗的头部猛烈相撞，尽管格雷罗立即报告了脑震荡症状，但蓝鸟主教练约翰·施奈德表示，格雷罗此后已通过所有必要测试，预计将在周六重返先发阵容。
“他感觉很好。过去的几天里，甚至在他去克利尔沃特（佛罗里达州）之前，他感觉都很好，”施奈德说。“他现在感觉正常，这是好事。”
那次克利尔沃特之行对格雷罗来说是一次回忆之旅，他与2017年曾效力的单A级达尼丁队一起进行康复训练。那支球队拥有众多顶级潜力新秀，从格雷罗到博·比谢特、卡文·比吉奥和丹尼·詹森。主教练是谁？是年轻的施奈德。
格雷罗在周四的康复赛中打出一支二垒安打并两次保送，这正是蓝鸟队想看到的。
球队内部希望，这次伤病名单之行虽然不幸，但也能让格雷罗休息身体的其他部位，以更充沛的精力回归。他本赛季一直受到背部问题和一些腿筋问题的困扰，但他很少缺席比赛。只要格雷罗完全摆脱这次脑震荡——施奈德对此非常重视，因为他在自己的小联盟捕手生涯中曾被诊断出七次脑震荡——一个全新的回归或许能帮助他走出本赛季漫长的低迷。
到目前为止，没有什么能改变他的状态。格雷罗在115场比赛中打击率为.263，仅打出7支本垒打，OPS为.693。他本赛季还没在罗杰斯中心打出过本垒打，这是这个无法解释的赛季中最奇怪的统计。
不过，施奈德在过去十年的执教生涯中一直相信格雷罗，从他们在佛罗里达州达尼丁的日子开始。没有迹象表明蓝鸟会让格雷罗离开他通常的第三棒位置，而如果多伦多真的想冲击本赛季的季后赛，就需要格雷罗重新站上前线，带领球队冲锋陷阵。
